prompts.prompt:
Cinematic emotional short film, live-action look, 16:9, 24 seconds, 24 fps. Characters: a ginger tabby cat that stands upright on its hind legs like a human, and a calico cat (black, white and orange). At the start the calico is zombie-like: cloudy pale eyes, torn fur hanging in shreds, sharp fangs. Opening setting: a dark rustic wooden cabin kitchen at night, pots on wooden shelves, a window with cold blue night light, wooden plank floor. Final setting: a green meadow at golden-hour sunset with white dandelion fluff floating in the air.

0:00-0:01.5 Extreme close-up of the ginger tabby with tears in his eyes, holding a black handgun with both paws, aimed toward the camera (gun out of focus in the foreground).

0:02-0:02.5 Over-the-shoulder wide shot from behind the ginger cat: he aims the handgun at the zombie calico slowly walking toward him across the wooden floor.

0:03-0:03.5 Front shot: the ginger cat stands upright, aiming with both paws, dark wooden wall and blue window behind him.

0:04-0:04.5 Close-up of the zombie calico, glassy pale eyes, then snarling with fangs.

0:05-0:06.5 Extreme close-up of the ginger cat's face, tears rolling down.

0:06.5-0:08 He stands aiming, then slowly lowers the gun.

0:08.5-0:09 The gun drops from his paw and he opens both arms wide for a hug.

0:09.5-0:10 Quick cuts: the zombie calico's face, then the ginger cat with eyes closed and a tear falling.

0:10.5 The calico leaps into his arms, wrapping her white paws around him; her fur is now healthy and normal.

0:11-0:13 Cut to the sunset meadow: the two cats roll and cuddle in the grass, white fluff floating around, warm golden light.

0:13-0:18 Close-up of the calico's affectionate face while the ginger cat's paw gently touches her face and head; the ginger cat lies on his back in the grass, eyes closed, peaceful.

0:18-0:20.5 The ginger cat's paw rests on her face; he looks up, content and relaxed.

0:21-0:22 Wide silhouette shot: the two cats sit snuggled together against the glowing sunset, tall grass and wildflowers in the foreground.

0:22.5-0:24 Close-up with sun flare: the ginger cat tenderly rubs his head against the calico's head. End.

Style: dramatic zombie-movie tension turning into a heartwarming ending, shallow depth of field, realistic fur detail, warm golden-hour light in the second half, dark low-key lighting in the first half.

Here's my prompt:

Create a 15-second cinematic anime skating-parkour sequence, anamorphic 2.39:1, as ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN CHASE SHOT.

The FIRST FRAME begins at full speed. No introduction, stationary pose, establishing shot, cuts, hidden transitions, or scene resets.

CHARACTER LOCK
Use the supplied RABBIT RACER character sheet as the exact visual reference for the heroine only. Do not reproduce its layout, labels, or typography.

Exactly ONE Rabbit Racer: the same face, white high ponytail, pink rabbit-ear racing helmet, white cropped racing top, oversized white-and-dusty-pink sleeves, black shorts, separate black thigh-high compression legwear, fingerless gloves, and integrated R-07 racing skates.

Preserve the reference silhouette, exposed upper-thigh areas, armor details, proportions, and white, dusty-pink, burgundy, black, and cyan palette. Do not replace her outfit with a full bodysuit.

Her rabbit ears are rigid helmet components. Her ponytail, sleeves, and fabric react naturally to speed.

R-07 SKATES
Preserve the reference mechanical skate construction: pink-and-white shells, visible wheels, articulated components, and cyan energy cores.

Wheels visibly roll against solid surfaces. Magnetic traction allows brief wall-riding on designated metal panels. Cyan acceleration pulses assist propulsion but never replace skating with effortless flight.

No new boots, disappearing wheels, rocket wings, or equipment transformations.

CONCEPT — THE HIGH-LINE SHORTCUT
Rabbit Racer is racing toward an elevated checkpoint before its access route closes. She takes a dangerous maintenance shortcut through the city.

This is athletic skating parkour: powerful strides, one-handed vaults, wall-rides, compressed landings, low sliding clearance, and committed gap jumps.

Every obstacle triggers a clear physical response. Maintain forward momentum while showing believable braking, compression, and acceleration.

ENVIRONMENT
Neo-Tokyo, 2188: a futuristic racing district with stacked magnetic tracks, maintenance walkways, suspended glass bridges, hovering transport vehicles, and a cloud-level racing circuit.

The entire route belongs to ONE connected elevated structure. Establish upcoming obstacles within the moving frame before she reaches them.

Late-sunset amber light mixes with pink-and-cyan neon. Recently wet surfaces reflect the city. Thin mist and steam create depth without hiding the route.

Spectators remain safely behind barriers. All road traffic uses hover or magnetic propulsion; visible wheels belong only to her racing skates.

0–3s — FULL-SPEED APPROACH AND VAULT
Start directly behind Rabbit Racer, already accelerating along an elevated racing boulevard. Her ponytail streams backward, knees flexed, torso low.

A maintenance barrier blocks the lane ahead. Beyond it, a sloped service panel connects to the outer metal wall.

Without stopping, she plants her left palm on the barrier’s top rail, tucks both knees, and performs a compact one-handed vault. Her skates clear the rail without clipping.

She lands on the sloped panel with compressed knees and immediately carries that momentum onto the adjacent magnetic wall.

Camera follows over the barrier on a slightly higher trajectory, keeping her whole body readable.

3–6s — WALL-RIDE AND TRANSFER
She carves along the wall above the closed lane, both skates visibly contacting its metal surface. Cyan magnetic traction glows tightly beneath the wheels.

Her body banks with the wall; one hand extends for balance. Keep the wall-ride short, fast, and physically connected to her entry momentum.

Ahead, the wall ends beside an open maintenance passage.

She compresses her legs and kicks away from the wall, crossing the short gap diagonally into the passage. She lands one skate slightly before the other, absorbs the impact, and resumes a low racing stance.

The camera follows on a wider parallel arc. Maintain a stable sense of gravity; do not roll the entire image upside down.

6–9s — LOW CLEARANCE
A heavy service crossbeam spans the passage at waist height, already visible as she lands.

She folds into a deep skating crouch, one leg slightly extended forward, chest close to her knees, and glides beneath it. Her helmet ears clear the beam by a small but visible margin.

Her gloved fingertips briefly skim the floor for balance. Tiny sparks come from a skate guard touching a metal seam.

The camera lowers behind her and passes through the SAME opening. No cut concealed by the beam.

She rises directly into two strong accelerating strides. Ahead, the passage opens onto a short glass skybridge.

9–12s — THE BREAKING BRIDGE
A damaged center section of the skybridge tilts downward, opening a short gap between the near platform and the intact far section.

Show both the takeoff edge and landing surface in the same moving view.

She bends deeply, drives off the solid edge, and jumps across. Her trajectory is one clean forward arc, not hovering.

At the apex, she draws her knees upward as a few glass fragments fall beneath her. Keep the action at near-real-time speed; no prolonged slow motion.

She lands on the intact far section with bent knees and both wheels gripping, then carves into the upward exit ramp without stopping.

The camera crosses the gap behind her on a slightly higher arc, briefly revealing the city far below while keeping her centered.

12–15s — CHECKPOINT BREAKOUT
The exit ramp curves directly into a large circular acceleration gate at the entrance to the cloud-level main raceway.

She leans forward and drives through the gate. A short cyan pulse intensifies beneath her skates, leaving tight fading energy trails.

The camera follows through the ring and emerges with her above the skyline. The previously enclosed route opens into an enormous suspended racing circuit.

She settles into a low aerodynamic stance and continues accelerating along the solid track.

End while she is still racing forward, with the camera struggling to keep pace and the city stretching beneath the track. No stop, victory pose, or fade to black.

CAMERA
One continuous rear chase shot, usually slightly offset so her silhouette and upcoming obstacles remain visible.

The camera behaves like an agile racing camera physically pursuing her along a continuous traversable route. Controlled vibration, small tracking errors, and wind buffeting communicate speed.

Keep Rabbit Racer near the center of frame. Use a moderately wide cinematic lens so her full body, contact points, and obstacles remain readable.

No teleports, impossible passage through solid structures, disconnected locations, reverse-angle cuts, or prolonged frontal views.

VISUAL STYLE
Ultra-detailed Japanese anime with cinematic material rendering, crisp character linework, expressive animation, subtle film grain, and restrained realistic motion blur.

Preserve readable hands, skates, helmet, and landing contact. Let peripheral scenery carry most of the speed blur.

Pink, cyan, white, and dusty rose accents against a dense futuristic city. Wet reflections, atmospheric depth, and restrained volumetric lighting. No lens flare.

PHYSICS AND CONTINUITY
Each action connects directly into the next:
vault → wall contact → kick-off → landing → low clearance → acceleration → gap jump → landing → acceleration gate.

Show clear takeoff, airborne trajectory, and landing for every jump.
Magnetic adhesion works only while the skates touch designated metal surfaces.
No sustained unsupported flight.
No skating on empty air.
No intersecting barriers or changing obstacle dimensions.
No duplicated heroine, extra limbs, costume changes, or skate redesigns.
The same connected city route remains visible throughout.

AUDIO
No music and no dialogue.

Only precise action sound design: wheels gripping ceramic and metal, magnetic traction hum, skate acceleration, glove contact on the rail, landing impacts, wind, metal scraping, cracking glass, distant hover traffic, muffled crowd reactions, and her controlled breathing.

Sound builds with speed and opens into a broader rushing wind as she emerges onto the skyline raceway.

No subtitles, text overlays, watermarks, or interface graphics.

Create a 30-second video in 1920×1080, with the realism of an ordinary recording a boyfriend made of his girlfriend during a summer walk in Japan.

The small story:
They have no particular destination. She has just opened a can of fruit juice, and he starts recording without announcing it. Over the next half-minute, she gradually notices the camera, gets a little embarrassed, and begins including him in the moment. Their familiarity should come through in how she waits for him, looks at him, and closes the distance between them.

The woman:
A beautiful Japanese woman around 24 years old, with an approachable, individual face rather than a polished model appearance. Dark brown eyes, natural skin texture, light everyday makeup, and straight black hair loosely gathered in a low ponytail. A few short strands around her temples have escaped in the summer humidity.

She wears a faded navy cotton T-shirt, loose ivory trousers, comfortable gray sneakers, and a small rust-colored crossbody bag. A plain elastic hair tie is around one wrist. Keep her facial features, hair, outfit, bag, and proportions consistent in every shot.

Her expressions are understated and responsive. Sometimes she looks distracted or squints in the light. Her smile develops because of something between them, rather than appearing on cue.

The place:
A residential neighborhood in a regional Japanese city, near a narrow canal. Late afternoon in midsummer, with warm sunlight still reaching the upper parts of the houses.

Use ordinary local details: patched asphalt, short concrete bridges over the canal, metal railings warm from the sun, compact houses with tiled roofs, frosted entrance windows, outdoor air-conditioning units, bicycles tucked beside gates, and plants growing in mismatched pots. Utility wires cross the sky. A striped fabric awning hangs outside a closed shop farther down the street.

Avoid famous landmarks and postcard compositions. The location should feel like somewhere the couple already knows.

How the camera behaves:
The boyfriend holds a small consumer camera at his own eye or chest level. Most of the time he is beside her or only a step behind. The viewpoint should feel like her companion's attention, with no third-person shots of the couple.

Let framing respond to their interaction. When she suddenly looks at him, he may take a fraction of a second to correct the composition. When he laughs, the camera moves slightly. When they walk, his footsteps create a gentle, uneven rhythm.

Use ordinary consumer-camera rendering: restrained detail, modest dynamic range, occasional clipped highlights, a little shadow noise, and slight focus hesitation when she moves closer. Preserve natural skin color.

Keep the camera's attention on her face, gestures, and shared surroundings. Avoid fashion poses, body-scanning shots, elaborate camera moves, slow motion, or a glossy advertising finish.

Suggested edit — six short memories from the same walk:

0:00–0:05
She stands beside a low canal railing with a small, unbranded can of mandarin orange juice. The recording begins just as she finishes lifting the pull tab. She takes a sip, lowers the can, and notices that he is filming.

She looks directly at him with a briefly puzzled expression, then gives a small, amused smile, as though silently asking, “Really, you're filming this?”

Begin with a slightly loose frame that includes her hands and the canal, then let the boyfriend adjust it toward her face.

0:05–0:10
A cut to the two of them walking side by side along the narrow lane. She carries the can naturally in one hand.

She gets half a step ahead, realizes he has slowed down while filming, and turns back. Instead of posing, she waits with a mildly impatient but affectionate look. Once he catches up, she resumes walking beside him.

Her gaze should meet the person holding the camera, not an imaginary audience.

0:10–0:15
They pause near a house entrance where a small glass wind chime hangs beneath the eaves.

A breeze makes it ring. She glances upward and listens for a moment. Loose strands of hair move against her cheek; she brushes them aside with her free hand.

She notices him still watching her through the camera and suppresses a smile before looking back toward the wind chime.

Keep this moment quiet and unhurried.

0:15–0:20
On a short concrete bridge, she stops to look down at the canal. The camera first catches the rippling water, then tilts back toward her after she has already turned around.

She leans slightly toward him to see what he is recording. Her face briefly comes too close for the camera's focus, making her laugh softly and step back.

The laugh should feel like a shared interruption, with a small answering movement from the camera.

0:20–0:25
They rest beside the bridge in the shade. She is closer to the camera now, relaxed enough to stop paying attention to being filmed.

She takes another small sip of juice, then holds the can toward him as an offer. Leave the can clearly visible in the foreground, separate from her face.

He does not take it during the shot. She gives a tiny questioning lift of her eyebrows, then draws it back with an affectionate smile.

0:25–0:30
She steps toward him and gently touches his free forearm, inviting him to keep walking. Only a small, natural part of his arm may enter the lower edge of the frame.

As they start moving together, he lowers the camera. The view drifts from her smiling face to her bag, their moving shadows, and the sunlit pavement.

Let the last second settle on the overlapping shadows of two people walking close together. End with an ordinary recording stop, without a dramatic transition or title.

Sound:
Use the sound that would actually reach the camera microphone: cicadas, the juice can opening, a few footsteps, a wind chime, faint canal water, distant tires on the road, and their quiet laughter.

A single softly spoken Japanese remark such as “撮ってたの？” may occur when she first notices the camera, but speech is optional. Do not add explanatory dialogue.

No music, voiceover, or added dramatic sound effects.

Continuity and physical detail:
There is one juice can, carried by her throughout the sequence. Its color, size, opening, and remaining shape stay consistent. The crossbody strap stays on the same shoulder. Her ponytail remains tied.

Hands should hold objects with believable contact and weight. Walking speed, foot placement, shadows, and reflections must agree with the surroundings. Keep the canal, bridge, houses, sunlight direction, and summer weather coherent between cuts.

Emotional direction:
The viewer should feel that she knows and trusts the person behind the camera. Build that feeling through small changes in distance and attention: noticing him, waiting for him, leaning in, offering a drink, and asking him to walk beside her.

Let ordinary pauses remain. Her beauty is something her boyfriend happens to notice during their time together.

The finished video should feel like a personal memory he would keep because of the way she looked at him that afternoon.

00:18–00:24 — The Chaotic Chase

The camera follows with energetic handheld movement, momentarily losing perfect framing as both characters move quickly.

00:24–00:27 — The Sudden Escape

The boy sprints out of the foreground, leaving the girl behind.

She stops near the railing and turns toward the camera.

Her breathing is slightly elevated.

Loose strands of hair fall around her face.

She gives a subtle dismissive look, as though the entire confrontation was nothing worth worrying about.

End abruptly, like an authentic viral smartphone clip.

Vertical 9:16 smartphone footage.

24 FPS with natural motion blur.

Handheld camera operated by a nearby friend.

SCENE 1 — A BUSY NEW YORK STREET (0–5 seconds)

A busy New York City street during the daytime, surrounded by tall modern buildings, authentic Manhattan architecture, glass storefronts, a realistic car showroom, yellow taxis, moving traffic, pedestrians, and people walking naturally along the sidewalks.

Outside a small bicycle repair workshop beside the showroom, a father is repairing an old bicycle while his 9-year-old son sits nearby holding a small toy car.

The workshop must look authentic, with realistic tools, bicycle parts, a workbench, and naturally arranged equipment.

The father works with genuine mechanical movements: carefully adjusting a bicycle chain, tightening a bolt with a wrench, repositioning the bicycle, and occasionally wiping his hands. His movements must follow realistic hand mechanics and body weight.

The child sits naturally, moving his fingers around the toy car and occasionally looking at the showroom display.

In the background, pedestrians walk at different speeds, cars pass through the street, and people interact naturally. Some pedestrians hold smartphones and casually record the busy street. Others check their phones, talk to companions, or continue walking without paying attention to the camera.

SCENE 2 — THE CHILD NOTICES SOMETHING (5–9 seconds)

A subtle futuristic electric humming sound gradually becomes audible beneath the natural New York street ambience.

A moving shadow passes over the pavement.

The child notices the changing light first. His eyes naturally shift toward the ground, followed by a small head movement as he looks upward.

His expression changes gradually from curiosity to genuine amazement. His eyebrows lift slightly, his eyes widen naturally, and his lips part a little. He pauses his hand movement while holding the toy car.

His father notices his son's reaction, pauses his bicycle repair, and naturally follows the child's gaze upward.

Several pedestrians begin noticing something unusual. One person slows down while walking, another raises a smartphone to record, and a couple turn their heads toward the sky.

Their reactions must be spontaneous and varied, not synchronized or exaggerated.

A stunning metallic silver flying Tesla-inspired vehicle emerges between the New York skyscrapers, descending toward the street.

Its proportions, reflections, and movement remain physically convincing. Its position and orientation stay consistent throughout the shot.

Camera: Begin with a medium shot of the child, then smoothly tilt upward to reveal the flying car between the buildings. Keep the transition continuous and cinematic.

SCENE 3 — THE FLYING CAR LANDS (9–14 seconds)

The futuristic silver flying car approaches the open space beside the bicycle workshop.

It decelerates smoothly, stabilizes above the pavement, and descends vertically with controlled movement. Subtle blue lights illuminate beneath the chassis.

Air from the vehicle's propulsion creates a gentle, believable movement in the child's hair and nearby loose clothing. The surrounding pedestrians react naturally, stepping back slightly or raising their phones to record.

The car lands with a subtle suspension response and settles firmly onto the pavement. Its body remains stable, with realistic reflections of buildings and pedestrians moving across its metallic surface.

The child takes a small, hesitant step forward, staring at the vehicle with growing excitement. His father stands beside him, visibly surprised but behaving naturally.

Important: The vehicle must not teleport, slide unnaturally, change shape, or suddenly rotate between frames. Maintain consistent geometry, lighting, shadows, and screen direction.

SCENE 4 — THE DRIVER AND THE HAPPY CHILD (14–18 seconds)

The driver's door opens naturally using a mechanically plausible hinge and the correct opening direction for the vehicle's actual design.

The door must remain attached to its proper hinges and follow one continuous, realistic arc. It must not detach, flip through the roof, intersect the car body, or change its opening mechanism mid-shot.

A well-dressed adult man exits the vehicle naturally. He shifts his weight, places his feet firmly on the pavement, straightens his posture, and looks toward the child with a warm smile.

He gives the child a welcoming hand gesture.

The boy's face brightens with genuine happiness. He smiles broadly, takes a few quick but natural steps toward the car, and looks excitedly at the open passenger doorway.

The man moves toward the passenger side and opens the passenger door using its actual, physically consistent mechanism.

The child approaches the opening, turns his body toward the seat, places one foot inside, supports himself with his hands, and climbs into the passenger seat naturally. His body must follow realistic human balance and joint movement.

He settles into the seat, adjusts his position, and looks toward the man with a joyful smile.

The father watches proudly from beside the bicycle workshop.

SCENE 5 — THE SPECTACULAR TAKEOFF (18–20 seconds)

The passenger door closes completely and securely.

The flying car pauses briefly on the pavement, creating a moment of anticipation.

Its futuristic propulsion system activates with a powerful but controlled electric energy effect. Blue illumination intensifies subtly beneath the chassis as the vehicle begins to rise vertically.

The takeoff starts with a slight, believable upward acceleration. The car lifts cleanly away from the street, maintaining its original orientation and stable geometry.

As it gains altitude, the camera smoothly tilts upward and pulls back to reveal the silver flying vehicle rising dramatically between the towering Manhattan skyscrapers.

Below, pedestrians look up and record the incredible moment on their phones. The father watches from the sidewalk.

The vehicle accelerates upward and forward, soaring into the New York skyline with an impressive cinematic sense of scale, speed, and freedom.

End on a breathtaking wide shot of the flying car disappearing between the skyscrapers.

REALISM REQUIREMENTS

Photorealistic New York City environment with authentic Manhattan architecture and busy street activity.
Natural pedestrian movement, independent reactions, believable walking cycles, and realistic smartphone-recording gestures.
Father must perform bicycle repair using anatomically correct hand movements, believable tool handling, and realistic body mechanics.
The child's facial features, hairstyle, clothing, age, and body proportions must remain consistent throughout the entire video.
Natural eye movements, blinking, facial expressions, breathing, posture changes, and walking mechanics.
No robotic gestures, exaggerated facial reactions, frozen pedestrians, duplicated people, or synchronized crowd movements.
Correct vehicle geometry, consistent door hinges, physically plausible door-opening direction, and uninterrupted mechanical movement.
Natural contact between the child's body, the passenger seat, the vehicle doors, and the ground.
Realistic shadows, reflections, depth of field, atmospheric perspective, and consistent lighting.
The flying car must remain visually identical across every scene.
No sudden cuts during important physical actions, no morphing, no floating feet, no clipping, and no impossible body movements.
The takeoff must feel spectacular and powerful while maintaining convincing cinematic realism.

CHARACTER: Seo-Yun, a petite 19-year-old Korean woman. Use the reference image for her exact face and identity. Messy black hair, oversized charcoal hoodie, black cargo pants, worn black sneakers. Realistic skin, eyes, expressions, and movement. No identity changes.

ENEMIES: Six adult male delinquents in dark streetwear. Their leader wears a long dark-brown coat and silver rings. Keep his appearance consistent.

LOCATION: An old concrete stairwell in Seoul during a thunderstorm. Wet steps, dripping rainwater, flickering red emergency lights, cold blue reflections, and vibrating metal railings.

FIGHTING STYLE: Taekwondo, practical boxing, and Hapkido. Fast dodges, punches, elbows, sweeps, turning kicks, and arm redirections. Every move must feel physical and realistic.

STATIC EFFECT: Thin white-blue sparks briefly appear around Seo-Yun’s fingers, hair, clothes, and shoes during sudden movement or impact. No magic, energy beams, or teleportation.

TIME EFFECT: Normal speed, followed by a 0.25-second slow-motion impact, then an instant return to normal speed.

00–04 — CORNERED

Seo-Yun climbs the wet stairs carrying a small paper bag. Six men block her path. The leader knocks the bag down and crushes the food under his shoe.

LEADER: “고개 숙여.”

Seo-Yun looks at the ruined food and lowers her eyes.

SEO-YUN: “그만해…”

He shoves her against the railing. She catches herself, trembling.

04–08 — AWAKENING

The leader punches toward her face. The blow clips her cheek, sending her against the wall. She touches her cheek and looks at her shaking fingers.

Her fear changes to disbelief. Tiny blue-white sparks appear on her sleeve.

SEO-YUN: “왜 자꾸…”

She ducks his next punch, redirects his arm, and hits his body with a powerful short punch. A brief static crackle sounds.

08–13 — STAIRWELL BURST

Three men rush down the stairs. Seo-Yun suddenly accelerates across the landing. She dodges a hook, blocks an arm, sweeps one attacker’s legs, and kicks another.

One hits the railing, another slides onto the lower landing, and the third stumbles against the wall. Water sprays as the camera quickly follows her movement.

13–18 — VERTICAL FIGHT

The remaining attackers charge from above. Seo-Yun avoids a grab, redirects an arm, strikes with her elbow, and follows with a turning roundhouse kick.

Her shoes grip the wet concrete. A brief slow-motion impact shows moving hair, compressed clothing, and sparks at contact. The railing shakes, and dust falls from the ceiling.

18–23 — THE LAST TWO

Two men approach together. Seo-Yun charges between them, dodges a punch, strikes one in the body, and spins into a back kick.

Both attackers fall realistically against the landing and wall.

Time snaps back to normal. Seo-Yun lands with bent knees, breathing heavily. She looks up at the leader.

23–27 — FINAL FIGHT

The leader charges down the stairs and throws a wide hook. Seo-Yun dodges, blocks his next strike, moves around his shoulder, and lands a short punch followed by a turning kick.

A 0.25-second slow-motion shot captures the kick hitting his torso, water spraying, and tiny sparks flashing at the impact.

He stumbles and collapses against the wall.

27–30 — THE EXIT

The sparks fade. The emergency lights stop flickering, but rainwater continues dripping.

Seo-Yun looks at the fading sparks between her fingers, frightened and confused.

SEO-YUN: “내 몸이… 왜 이래?”

She picks up the ruined paper bag, looks at it sadly, and walks up the final stairs into the rainy night.

CUT TO BLACK.

CAMERA AND SOUND

Use handheld tracking, low-angle full-body shots, close-ups of her eyes, wide stairwell shots, realistic focus changes, and natural motion blur. The camera briefly struggles to keep up during speed bursts.

Sound includes Korean dialogue, rain, dripping water, footsteps, breathing, clothing movement, metal vibrations, body impacts, and subtle static crackles.

No background music, subtitles, or narration.

REALISM RULES

One consistent Seo-Yun identity. Realistic human anatomy, foot placement, balance, momentum, wet-surface traction, and gravity. Water reacts naturally to movement. No floating bodies, duplicate people, gore, impossible movements, or sudden location changes.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No anime, cartoon effects, artificial-looking characters, magic, energy beams, supernatural shockwaves, teleportation, exaggerated slow motion, or unrealistic physics.

She wears a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, and a simple silver necklace. Maintain consistent facial identity, outfit, and body proportions throughout.

**STORY:**

She wakes up from an evening nap in her modest Seoul apartment, looking sleepy and confused. She sits on the bed, rubs her eyes, stretches lazily, and checks the time on an old bedside clock. Her messy ponytail is half undone, and she yawns at the camera before saying, “Wait… is it evening already?”

She slips on her sneakers, grabs a little shopping bag, and leaves the apartment. The camera follows her down the stairs and through a narrow residential street filled with parked bicycles, overhead wires, small shops, and warm evening sunlight.

She visits a tiny neighborhood convenience shop, picks up potato chips, chocolate, instant noodles, and a bottled drink, then examines a snack packet suspiciously before laughing at the camera. She pays at the counter and walks outside with her purchases.

Feeling thirsty, she stops at an outdoor public water tap beside a small neighborhood park. She unties her ponytail, lets her long black hair fall naturally around her shoulders, splashes a little water onto her face, and drinks directly from the running tap with her hands cupped beneath it. Water drips from her fingers, and she laughs when a little splashes onto her top. She wipes her face with her hand and shakes her loose hair back casually.

She sits on a low concrete wall beneath the trees, opens her chips, takes a crunchy bite, and watches children playing and neighbors walking past. She offers a snack toward the camera as if sharing it with her friend filming.

Finally, she walks back home along the quiet street, carrying her snacks. At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera with a sleepy but happy smile and says, “Okay, now I'm ready for the evening!” The footage ends abruptly as her friend laughs and the camera tilts toward the ground.

30-second cinematic live-action video, 16:9 aspect ratio, 24 fps, shot on spherical prime lenses with fine film grain. An abandoned mountain shrine courtyard at blue hour, just after sunset. A thin layer of rainwater covers the worn grey flagstones, mirroring the sky and the blades. Moss-covered stone lanterns line the sides, a broken red-lacquer torii gate with a cracked crossbeam stands at the far end, and a flight of mossy stone steps leads up to a dark shrine hall with a hanging rope and a rusted bronze bell. Fine mist drifts between the pillars. A few dim, warm amber paper lanterns glow softly in the background. Pale petals and wet leaves drift down in slow, thin rain. Color grade: cool slate-blue shadows, soft grey-green mist, muted earth tones, gentle warm highlights from the lanterns. Natural and filmic, nothing oversaturated.

CAMERA RULE: dynamic shoulder-mounted handheld with real weight and micro-shake, mixed with occasional low floating glides on the wet floor and a few whip pans. The operator stays close to the action and is never perfectly stable.

CHARACTER A (use Image A as reference): a real young woman in her early 20s with fair skin, a short wavy dark-brown bob with wispy bangs, and a small black bow clip on the right side of her head. She wears her oversized lavender varsity jacket with cream striped trims and a cream “B” patch over a black tank, light-wash wide-leg jeans (hems soaked and darker), and chunky black sneakers. Her sword blade is a solid beam of cold silver-white light with a soft pale sapphire edge, reflected in the water under her feet.

CHARACTER B (use Image B as reference): a real young woman in her early 20s with fair skin, a beauty mark on her cheek, very long straight jet-black hair with wispy bangs, silver hoop earrings and a thin silver necklace. She wears her black satin bomber jacket over a white crop tank, washed-black cargo pants and white chunky sneakers that get muddier through the fight. Her sword blade is a solid beam of deep burnt-copper and ember-amber light, casting warm reflections on the wet stone.

PHYSICS RULE: every step, slide and landing throws sheets of water. Droplets catch the blade light. Where a blade touches the surface it leaves a brief glowing wake and hissing steam.

CHOREOGRAPHY RULE: no long pauses. Each exchange ends in a 2-3 frame freeze pose (back-turned stance with the blade pointing behind, low crouch with the blade skimming the water, one-handed overhead guard, mid-air spin).

TIMELINE

0.0-3.0s | LOW GLIDE THROUGH THE MIST. 35mm, camera 40 cm above the water, gliding slowly forward past a stone lantern. Rain taps the puddles. Through the mist, A stands on the steps in front of the shrine hall, B at the broken torii gate, 8 m apart. B drags her unlit sword hilt along the torii pillar with a metallic scrape. A rings the rusted bell once, and the low tone ripples the water. At 2.2s both blades ignite, silver-sapphire and ember-copper, lighting the mist around them. Sound: rain, distant bell tone, rising electric hum.

3.0-6.0s | THE CHARGE. 24mm handheld, tracking sideways at running speed. Both sprint across the flooded flagstones, sending sheets of water outward. They meet at the center with a huge flash. Three fast strikes and parries. At 4.9s A slides on her knees under B’s horizontal slash, drenching herself, and swings up. Sound: splashes, crackling impacts, sneakers slapping on wet stone.

6.0-9.0s | CLOSE-UP, MIRRORED FACES. 65mm, shallow depth of field. Tight on A, breathing hard, wet strands of bob stuck to her cheek, silver light on her face. A fast whip pan at 7.2s lands on B, who smirks, shakes the water from her hair and flips the sword to a reverse grip. Behind her, the reflection of her blade ripples on the floor. Sound: whoosh, breaths, hum.

9.0-12.0s | THE LANTERN BREAK. 28mm, handheld, orbiting 120 degrees. B pushes A back toward a moss-covered stone lantern. A runs up the lantern’s side, flips over B and lands behind her. B’s slash misses and slices the lantern’s cap clean off. The stone top slides slowly and drops into the water with a heavy splash, sending a ring wave across the courtyard that both girls jump over. Sound: stone grind, huge splash, echo.

12.0-15.0s | LOW ANGLE, THE STEP LEAP. 24mm, camera 30 cm off the ground, tilted up, dragged beside them. B bounds up the stone steps and leaps off the top step with an overhead arc at 13.2s. A meets it from below with a rising slash. The blades lock above the lens in a burst of sparks and a spray of droplets lit silver and amber. They land on opposite sides at 14.6s in mirrored back-turned poses, water rippling outward between them. Sound: heavy impact crack, low boom.

15.0-18.0s | OVER-THE-SHOULDER, RAPID EXCHANGE. 35mm, circling from over B’s shoulder to over A’s within 1.5s. Six rapid strikes: horizontal, diagonal, a low sweep A jumps over, a thrust B sidesteps. At 16.8s B skims her blade along the water and flicks it up, throwing a curtain of glowing droplets into A’s face. A answers by sliding under B’s next slash. Light trails of 2-3 frames follow the blades. Sound: rapid overlapping strikes, splashing steps.

18.0-21.0s | THE TORII CUT. 32mm. A leaps, runs three steps up the red torii pillar, flips off it and slashes down. B blocks and sidesteps, and A’s blade slices through the cracked crossbeam. The beam falls slowly and lands across the water, sending a wave outward. Both girls jump back from the splash. Sound: wood crack, heavy splash, ringing echo.

21.0-24.0s | THE BOW, SLOW MOTION. 85mm, 40% speed, shallow depth of field. B’s blade slices past A’s head and cuts the black bow clip from her hair. A few strands float with it. Time slows. The bow turns lazily in the air, a single silver droplet rolling off it, and lands on the water, floating on its own ripple. The blades hum on either side. A’s eyes flick to it, then back to B with a small, challenging smile. Sound: sustained low hum, muffled heartbeat, a tiny splash.

24.0-27.0s | EXTREME CLOSE-UP, BLADE LOCK. 85mm, focus at the crossing point. The blades cross in the center of the frame, sparks hissing in the rain. Faces in profile on either side, A lit silver-blue, B lit amber. Raindrops sizzle and burst into steam on the blades. At 26.3s they push apart in a flare and each steps back. Sound: sustained electric grind with sizzling, then a sharp release.

ORIGINALITY:
Everything in this scene must be completely original and fictional. Do not reference, imitate, or reproduce any existing movie, animation, game, advertisement, robot design, character, company, trademark, logo, or copyrighted visual style. Kima is an entirely original fictional robot.
CORE CONCEPT:
A young fictional girl discovers a mysterious oversized box and excitedly unboxes an adorable futuristic metallic pink robot. The scene begins as a curious unboxing and gradually becomes a sweet, funny first-meeting moment between the girl and her new robot friend.
GIRL:
A fictional young child, approximately 7–9 years old, with a lovely natural face, expressive pretty eyes, neatly styled natural hair, and realistic child-like facial expressions. She wears simple bright pink shorts with a casual child-friendly top. Natural proportions, realistic skin texture, realistic hair strands and believable movements. She behaves naturally and innocently throughout the scene.
ROBOT — “KIMA”:
A completely original futuristic humanoid robot approximately the height of a small adult. Smooth metallic pink exterior, polished reflective surfaces, subtle silver mechanical details, softly glowing original eyes, rounded friendly facial design, realistic articulated joints and hands. The robot should look physically manufactured from metal, not like a cartoon character or existing fictional robot.
LOCATION:
A bright modern home interior with natural daylight coming through windows. A large mysterious matte-white box sits on the floor. The box has completely original minimal markings:
“KIMA”
“PERSONAL ROBOT”
No recognizable logos or trademarks.
CAMERA:
One continuous camera movement from beginning to end. No cuts, no jump cuts, no scene transitions, no teleportation, no sudden changes of position. The camera begins at a medium-wide angle showing the girl and large box, then naturally moves closer during the robot reveal, follows the robot's movement, and ends in an intimate medium shot of the girl and robot together.
0–6 SECONDS:
The girl kneels beside the large box, excited and curious.
She looks at the camera and says naturally:
“Okay… let's see what's inside!”
She carefully opens the large box.
The lid slowly moves upward.
A faint mechanical glow becomes visible inside.
The girl's eyes widen.
She whispers:
“Whoa…”
6–12 SECONDS:
The metallic pink robot slowly rises from inside the box.
The camera smoothly moves toward the robot, revealing its full size and highly reflective metallic-pink body.
Realistic mechanical sounds accompany its movement.
The robot steps backward slightly, then takes one gentle step forward.
The girl looks up at it with genuine amazement.
The robot slowly lowers itself and sits/kneels down at the girl's eye level in a friendly, non-threatening manner.
The camera continues moving naturally with the action.
12–19 SECONDS:
The girl smiles and says:
“Hi, Kima! How are you?”
The robot looks directly at her.
Its eyes glow softly.
Kima replies politely in a warm, gentle voice:
“Hi, cutie. I'm doing great. How's it going?”
The girl giggles.
She says:
“Pretty good… but I didn't know robots could be this shiny.”
Kima looks down at its metallic pink body.
Then says humorously:
“I polish myself every morning.”
The girl laughs.
19–25 SECONDS:
The girl asks:
“So… what can you do?”
Kima answers with playful confidence:
“I can help you, learn new things, tell jokes…”
Brief pause.
“…and I am excellent at keeping secrets.”
The girl smiles and says:
“Can you be my friend?”
Kima pauses for a moment, looking at her warmly.
Then replies:
“I was hoping you would ask.”
25–30 SECONDS:
The girl reaches out her hand.
Kima gently extends its metallic hand and gives her a soft, friendly handshake.
The girl says:
“Then it's official. We're friends.”
Kima responds:
“Deal. Best friends?”
The girl smiles:
“Best friends.”
Kima's eyes glow slightly brighter.
The camera slowly moves around them while keeping both characters clearly visible.
END with the girl standing beside Kima, smiling naturally while the robot remains beside her like a protective new friend.
VISUAL QUALITY:
Extreme photorealism. Realistic child appearance, natural skin texture, individual hair strands, physically accurate hands and fingers, realistic fabric physics, realistic metallic reflections, accurate reflections on the robot's polished pink surface, realistic mechanical joints, physically believable robot movement, natural eye reflections, cinematic depth of field, realistic environmental lighting, natural shadows, subtle lens behavior, realistic ambient sound and mechanical audio.
MOTION CONSISTENCY:
Maintain perfect character identity and appearance throughout the entire 30 seconds. The girl's face, hairstyle, clothing and body proportions must remain consistent. Kima's metallic-pink body, proportions, face, eye design and mechanical details must remain exactly consistent.
CONTINUITY REQUIREMENTS:
ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT.
NO CUTS.
NO JUMP CUTS.
NO FRAME BREAKS.
NO MISSING FRAMES.
NO FLICKERING.
NO CHARACTER DUPLICATION.
NO EXTRA PEOPLE.
NO EXTRA ROBOTS.
NO RANDOM OBJECTS APPEARING.
NO DISAPPEARING OBJECTS.
NO TELEPORTATION.
NO ENVIRONMENT CHANGES.
NO CAMERA JUMPS.
NO DEFORMED HANDS.
NO EXTRA FINGERS.
NO DISTORTED FACES.
NO MELTING METAL.
NO UNNATURAL ROBOT LIMBS.
NO UNEXPECTED TEXT.
NO RANDOM LOGOS.
NO WATERMARKS.
Keep the physics, lighting, shadows, reflections, character positions, dialogue timing, facial expressions and environment consistent from the first frame to the final frame.
The final result should look like an expensive, professionally filmed live-action science-fiction family commercial, but with completely original fictional characters and design. The emotional progression should be:
CURIOSITY → SURPRISE → HUMOR → CONNECTION → FRIENDSHIP.

Seedance 2.5｜10秒｜9:16竖屏
自然写实的户外足球场互动，一个连续长镜头。

【人物绑定】
@图片1为唯一人物角色卡，人物外貌、发型、穿着和配饰均遵循角色卡，全程保持一致。

人物左手拿着一部手机。手机从开始到结束始终留在左手，不换手、不消失。

【环境与摄影】
傍晚的户外足球场，温暖的低角度阳光从侧面照来。前景是一条沿球场边缘弯曲延伸的浅灰色水泥步道，旁边紧接着绿色草地。

右后方中远景有一座完整可见的白色足球门和球网，两名远处球员在球门附近，后方是茂密树木。人物与球门之间有清楚、无遮挡的射门空间。

镜头位于步道前方，面对走来的人物，保持自然手机拍摄般的真实感。全程连续拍摄，不剪切、不换机位、不使用慢动作。

构图同时容纳人物全身、脚边足球、足球飞行空间和远处球门。踢球与进球过程中，脚部接触和足球入网都必须看得见。

【0—3秒｜看手机走来，足球弹近】
人物左手拿手机，低头看着屏幕，沿水泥步道自然朝镜头走来，右臂随步伐轻轻摆动。

一只足球从人物身后、画面右侧的球场方向进入画面，经过几次连续的地面弹跳，逐渐接近人物脚边。每次落地后的反弹高度降低，运动轨迹自然连续。

人物察觉脚边的动静，短暂抬眼，放慢脚步并停下来。

【3—5秒｜看向球场，右脚踩停】
人物转头看向画面右后方的球场，身体随之侧转，左手仍拿着手机。足球最后低低弹落，滚到脚前。

约3.5—4.8秒，球场方向传来一位男生带距离感的呼喊：
“Sorry, can we have it back?”

这句话由远处球员说出，主要人物不对这句话做口型。

人物低眼看球，以左脚支撑身体，抬起右脚，用右脚鞋底前掌轻轻压住足球顶部，将球踩停。鞋底必须真实接触球顶，足球在接触后停止滚动。

停稳片刻，人物抬开右脚，让足球向草地边缘、球门方向轻轻滚出一小段，为射门留出空间。

【5—6秒｜转身，右脚踢出侧旋弧线球】
人物转为背对镜头、面向远处球门，快速看一眼球门位置。左手继续握着手机，右臂自然展开保持平衡。

人物以略微侧身的角度靠近足球，左脚稳稳支撑在球旁，右腿向后摆动，随后带动髋部向前转动。

约第6秒，右脚内脚背斜向擦击足球偏侧的后下部。触球既有向前的力量，也有擦过球面的横向力量，让足球获得前进速度、适度上升角度与明显侧旋。

右脚完成触球后自然横向随摆，支撑脚轻微转动释放身体力量，然后收脚站稳。动作熟练、干净、轻松，左手始终握着手机。

【6—8秒｜足球旋转、弯入球门】
足球在真实触球之后才离开地面，带着清楚的侧向旋转飞向远处球门。球面拼块随旋转改变朝向，保持真实尺寸和运动模糊。

从人物面向球门的方向看，足球先向球门右侧方向飞出，随后在持续前进的过程中平滑地向左弯回，形成一条清楚可见的侧向弧线。

轨迹同时具有适度的上升和下坠，但最醒目的特点是横向弯曲。弯曲连续自然，不突然折角，不中途停顿，不像被遥控牵引。

约7.5—8秒，足球从白色门柱之间、横梁下方进入球门，击中球网。球网被足球撞出明显凹陷，随后回弹晃动，足球落在球门内部。

必须清楚呈现完整结果：
侧旋飞行 → 平滑弯向球门 → 穿过门框范围 → 撞网 → 球网回弹。

远处球员跟随足球轨迹转头，看到球弯入球门。镜头保持连续，不能通过切镜跳过足球飞行或入网过程。

【8—10秒｜继续看手机走来，远处喊话】
人物踢完后收脚站稳，自然转回面向镜头，重新低头看左手手机，继续沿步道朝镜头走来。

姿态轻松从容，像顺手完成了一次漂亮的射门，不停下来摆庆祝姿势。

约8.3—9.5秒，球场方向传来同一位男生清楚、带惊喜和笑意的呼喊：
“I love you baby”

这是后段唯一对白，完整说一次，不添加其他词句，不重复。

人物听到后短暂抬眼，露出自然、略带得意的轻笑，随后把目光落回手机，继续走向镜头。主要人物不对这句远处呼喊做口型。

第10秒在自然行走的画面中结束，不淡黑、不定格。

【声音】
真实户外环境声：轻微风声、远处球场活动声、鞋底踩过水泥路的脚步声、足球弹跳声。

右脚触球时出现清楚的一声闷响，足球入网时有短促的球网抖动声。

两句对白都来自球场方向，带适度距离感，文字准确：

前段：“Sorry, can we have it back?”
后段：“I love you baby”

主要人物全程不说话。不要额外添加旁白、其他对白或覆盖人声的音乐。

【连续性与动作约束】
全片保持同一人物、同一只足球、同一部左手持握的手机。

严格保持动作顺序：
足球弹跳接近 → 右脚前掌踩球顶停住 → 松脚让球滚出少许 → 转身看球门 → 左脚支撑 → 右脚内脚背擦击 → 足球带侧旋离地 → 平滑弯入球门 → 撞网 → 人物转回继续走。

侧旋来自右脚与球侧面的真实擦击。脚尚未接触足球时，球不能提前飞走。

足球只射出一次，只进入球门一次。不要增加颠球、重复射门、脚后跟踢球或人物原地旋转表演。

足球不能只落在球门附近，必须穿过门框并撞到球网。不要穿过门柱、横梁或球网，不要突然瞬移进门。

避免足球复制、球体漂浮、轨迹折角、手脚变形、手机换手、人物变脸、服装变化和背景位置跳动。

不添加轨迹光线、火焰、漫画特效、字幕、标题、水印或标志。

THE CORONATION — 20-SECOND CINEMATIC COMEDY

MODEL: Seedance 2.5
DURATION: 20 seconds
ASPECT RATIO: 16:9
STYLE: Photorealistic live-action medieval fantasy film with subtle absurdist comedy.
REFERENCE IMAGES AND CHARACTER LOCK
Use the uploaded King character sheet, Prince character sheet, and Random Man character sheet as the definitive visual references.
King: Preserve his exact face, gray-streaked hair, beard, crown, and burgundy royal outfit.

Prince: Preserve his exact face, hairstyle, navy-and-gold coronation outfit, blue cloak, and crown once placed.

Random Man: Preserve his exact face, hairstyle, modern casual outfit, and body proportions.

Maintain consistent character identities, costumes, lighting, and the layout of the throne room throughout the entire video.
LOCATION AND ATMOSPHERE
An enormous medieval royal throne room with towering stone pillars, golden chandeliers, tall stained-glass windows, red velvet banners, and a magnificent golden throne. The royal court stands silently on either side of a red carpet.

The atmosphere is extremely serious and emotionally grand, like the climax of an epic fantasy film. Warm golden sunlight streams through the windows. The music is majestic, with a full orchestral score.

The modern man must look completely out of place in this medieval setting.

SHOT 1 — THE MOMENT OF CORONATION

0–5 seconds

Wide cinematic establishing shot of the royal throne room. The prince kneels on a cushion before the king. The king stands solemnly in front of him, holding an ornate golden crown with both hands.

The court watches in absolute silence.
Cut to a medium close-up of the king slowly raising the crown above the prince's head.

The king speaks in a deep, solemn voice:

KING: "Today, you become king."

The orchestral music swells dramatically. The prince bows his head with complete seriousness.

SHOT 2 — THE WRONG MAN ENTERS

5–9 seconds

Just as the king is about to lower the crown, a casually dressed modern man in a dark hoodie, jeans, and sneakers walks into the royal ceremony from the side of the hall.

He walks directly between the king and prince as though he belongs there.
The king freezes with the crown suspended in midair. The prince remains kneeling, looking slightly confused. The courtiers stare in silent disbelief.

The modern man barely acknowledges anyone. He notices the crown, looks at it critically, and gives a small disapproving shake of his head.

The orchestral music abruptly softens into an awkward, sustained note.

SHOT 3 — THE UNEXPECTED FIX

9–14 seconds

In one continuous, clearly visible action, the modern man casually takes the crown from the king's hands.

He notices a small paper price tag hanging from the crown, removes it, and slips it into his pocket. He then gently straightens the prince's crooked collar and nudges the royal throne a few inches into better alignment with the carpet.
His movements are practical, quick, and completely unbothered.

The king stands frozen, visibly bewildered but trying to preserve his royal dignity. The prince looks from the man to his father, unsure whether he is allowed to move.

The man steps back, examines his work, and gives one satisfied nod.

RANDOM MAN: "Much better."

Deliver the line casually, in a natural conversational voice, without a dramatic pause or exaggerated comic delivery.

SHOT 4 — BACK TO BUSINESS

14–17 seconds

The modern man turns around and casually walks out of the throne room the same way he entered.

No one stops him. Nobody speaks.
The king slowly follows him with his eyes, then looks down at the crown in his hands as if trying to understand what just happened.

The prince remains kneeling in the exact same position.

The man exits the frame completely.

SHOT 5 — THE CORONATION CONTINUES

17–20 seconds

Cut to a cinematic medium close-up of the king taking a slow breath, regaining his composure, and carefully positioning himself to continue the ceremony.

He raises the crown again.
The prince bows his head.

The orchestral music resumes its original majestic intensity, as if the interruption never happened.

KING: "Today… you become king."

End immediately on the king's perfectly serious face.

Cut to black.

CAMERA AND EDITING

Use professional cinematic framing, smooth controlled camera movements, realistic depth of field, natural facial micro-expressions, and clean film-style cuts. Establish the room before moving into medium shots and close-ups. Make the modern man's entrance and practical actions easy to see.

Keep the comedy understated and driven by timing, awkward silence, and the contrast between the epic ceremony and the man's mundane behavior.

AUDIO DESIGN

Majestic orchestral music during the coronation, subtle footsteps and clothing movement, a slight musical interruption when the man enters, a soft paper rustle as he removes the price tag, and a return to full orchestral grandeur for the final line.

All dialogue must be clearly audible, naturally delivered, and spoken in English. No narration, no subtitles, no extra dialogue, and no random background voices.

STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No cartoon effects, no slapstick falls, no exaggerated facial expressions, no character morphing, no identity changes, no costume changes, no duplicated characters, no extra limbs, no floating objects, no random camera transitions, no modern objects apart from the man's clothing and the tiny price tag, and no characters looking directly into the camera.

The king, prince, and courtiers must treat the event as a real interruption to a serious royal ceremony. The modern man must remain completely calm and behave as though fixing the coronation is an ordinary task.

FINAL CREATIVE DIRECTION: Make it look like a genuine, high-budget medieval fantasy movie that has been interrupted by a man who thinks he is responsible for fixing continuity errors. The audience should find the situation funny without the characters turning it into a comedy performance.

ZERO CAUTIOUS CHOREOGRAPHY.
FAST, FORCEFUL, DECISIVE, CONTINUOUS.

两人都主动进攻，动作突然、强硬、全身投入。
禁止谨慎试探、慢慢接近、轻轻推挡、长时间蓄力或等待对方表演。

COMMITTED BODY MOVEMENT
→ CLEAR ATTACK PATH
→ VISIBLE CONTACT
→ STRONG PHYSICAL REACTION
→ IMMEDIATE NEXT ACTION.

一次只有一个主要动作焦点。
每次攻击的起点、运动路径、接触点与结果必须清楚。
防守成功后立即反击或改变进攻角度。
不使用混乱剪辑掩盖没有接触的动作。

两人势均力敌。
都要承受冲击、出现短暂失衡并真实恢复。
PYONA不能轻松破解所有毒系能力。
POMIRA不能只站着让召唤兽战斗。

【PYONA / 水系规则】

清水始终无色透明，具有真实折射、重量、惯性和飞溅。
不是蓝色激光、发光能量、冰或固体玻璃。

HYDRO INTERCEPT：
掌前发射短促、紧凑的透明高压水弹，截击飞来的毒刺。

HYDRO STEP：
真实蹬地，脚后清水高速向后喷开，推动身体向前加速。
必须看见连续移动路线，绝不是瞬移。

HYDRAULIC STRIKE：
水流紧贴拳、前臂或腿部运动。
身体先真实接触目标，再从接触点爆发水压。

WATER GUARD：
前臂附近高速旋转的薄透明水膜。
用于承受冲击、改变攻击方向或把毒液带向侧面。
不是静态球形护盾。

水不能自动净化毒。
清水接触毒液后变成半透明紫色污染水。
污染水不能突然恢复透明。
PYONA将污染水甩离身体，不回收、不重复使用。
后续攻击使用新凝聚的清水或未受污染的残水。

【POMIRA / 紫色毒系规则】

所有毒系效果统一为深紫色、暗紫色或半透明紫色。
全片禁止绿色毒液、绿色毒雾、绿色毒蟾和绿色污染痕迹。

毒液比水更黏稠，具有拉丝、挂滴和附着感。
紫色来自液体本身，不依靠霓虹发光。
禁止紫色激光、能量球或发光电弧。

POISON NEEDLES：
三枚由深紫色毒液压缩形成的细长液态毒刺。
不是金属飞镖或普通刀具。

POISON MIST：
浓密紫色毒雾，用于遮挡视线并掩护真实移动。
不是瞬移烟雾或空间传送。

VENOM PALM：
深紫色毒液贴着掌缘与前臂，配合真实掌击或手刀。

VENOM TOAD：
仅出现一只，站立高度约为成年人的两倍。
宽大沉重身体、粗壮四肢、暗紫色粗糙湿润皮肤。
表面覆盖厚重深紫色毒性黏液。
真实生物肌肉与重量，不是卡通宠物或机械兽。

毒蟾能凭坚韧皮肤和厚黏液承受水压攻击，但必须有明确受力反应。
外形、体量和纹理从出现到消失保持一致。

毒液危险性通过攻击距离、石材腐蚀和人物反应表现。
无血液、无开放伤口、无皮肤溶解。

【00:00–00:04 — 紫色毒刺 × 高压水精准截击】

第一帧直接进入冲突，不拍空大堂，不拍慢走。

POMIRA眼部极近景，仅约0.3秒。
目光锐利，嘴角带极短挑衅笑意。

立即切侧前方中景，建立两人约8米距离。

POMIRA猛地甩臂，三枚深紫色液态毒刺先后高速射向PYONA。
三枚有清楚的时间间隔，不同时挤满画面。

PYONA迅速连续改变掌部方向，发射三次短促透明高压水弹。
每次精准对应一枚毒刺。

POISON NEEDLE FLIGHT
→ WATER INTERCEPTION
→ VISIBLE MID-AIR CONTACT
→ PURPLE CONTAMINATED DROPLETS BURST.

前两次在两人之间碰撞。
第三枚毒刺更快，逼近PYONA脸侧。
她在距脸约半米处完成最后一次强力截击。

冲击近景：
发丝被爆开的液体气流掀动，眼神没有失去目标。
紫色污染水滴向侧面甩出，不接触她的眼睛。

不使用慢动作。
最后一次截击直接衔接向前踏步。

【00:04–00:07 — HYDRO STEP / 爆发突进】

PYONA真实蹬地。
脚底清水被猛烈向后喷开。
她沿清楚直线迅速缩短8米距离。

REAL FOOT PUSH
→ BACKWARD WATER BURST
→ VISIBLE FORWARD BODY TRAVEL.

鞋底在大理石上留下连续水迹。
透明水流缠住右前臂，形成紧凑旋转压缩水层。
身体前倾、肩髋推进，右拳已经进入攻击线。

摄影机侧向快速跟拍。
必须看见她从原位置冲向POMIRA，不用切镜伪装瞬移。

POMIRA不僵住。
她立即压低重心，右手猛地按向地面。
脸上挑衅笑意转为冷静、专注。

【00:07–00:11 — VENOM TOAD / 巨大紫色毒蟾拦截】

POMIRA右手掌真正接触大理石。

掌下深紫色毒液快速扩散成不规则圆形液面。
不出现文字、符号、复杂魔法阵或手印序列。

液面猛烈鼓起。
巨大的暗紫色毒蟾从翻涌毒液中迅速形成。
身体先成形，粗壮前肢随后重压地面。
沉重落地声与轻微地板震动同步出现。

POMIRA被正在升起的背部托起。
双脚调整，屈膝稳定地站上毒蟾背部。
不能切镜后凭空出现在背上。

低角度3/4稍宽镜头建立巨兽体量。

PYONA不停止冲刺等待。
右拳在毒蟾前胸成形后立即真实命中。

FIST CONTACT
→ SKIN AND MUCUS COMPRESSION
→ HYDRAULIC BURST
→ TOAD FRONT BODY JOLTS.

毒蟾前胸明显后震，前脚猛烈撑地抵住冲击。
它没有倒下，但绝不能毫无反应。
POMIRA在背上屈膝吸收震动，重新稳定重心。

接触区清水被毒性黏液染成紫色，向外爆散。
PYONA立即撤拳，不回收污染水。

【00:11–00:16 — 强力旋转侧踢 / 毒液反溅】

PYONA借右拳回弹直接转髋。
不后退摆姿势，不停下来蓄力。

她完成快速、全身投入的旋转侧踢。
脚掌准确撞中毒蟾前胸偏侧位置。

VISIBLE TARGET
→ FULL HIP ROTATION
→ REAL FOOT CONTACT
→ DEEP SURFACE COMPRESSION
→ WATER PRESSURE EXPLOSION.

踢击强硬、沉重。
毒蟾身体向侧后方偏移，脚掌在大理石上滑出短距离。
厚黏液受到挤压，突然向PYONA上身和脸部方向反溅。

PYONA收腿落地的同时立即抬起左前臂。
透明WATER GUARD高速旋转，把迎面紫色毒液带向外侧。

POISON CONTACTS WATER FILM
→ WATER TURNS PURPLE
→ CONTAMINATED LIQUID IS THROWN SIDEWAYS.

她前臂后震半拍，鞋底滑动，随后马上站稳。
污染水落向旁边地板，不重新包裹她的身体。

极短表情插镜：
PYONA眉头收紧，呼吸加重。
POMIRA在背上俯视她，眼神具有压迫感。

表情镜头不超过半秒，立即继续动作。

【00:16–00:20 — 高压水捕获 / 紫色毒水反喷】

PYONA迅速侧移，抬掌发射一股短而猛烈的透明高压水柱。
目标锁定毒蟾嘴部。

毒蟾突然张口。
水柱真正进入嘴里，被短暂收住。
下颌、颈部出现真实吞收动作。

下一瞬间，它猛地向前伸头，将收到的水与自身毒液混合，喷出一股更粗、更黏稠的深紫色毒水。

WATER ENTERS MOUTH
→ BRIEF HOLD
→ PURPLE CONTAMINATED RETURN JET.

不能凭空生成无关光束。

PYONA看到喷射起势，立即向侧面爆发跳避。
身体真实离开原攻击线。
毒水穿过她原来的站位，击中后方石柱。

STONE CONTACT
→ HEAVY PURPLE SPLASH
→ SMALL STONE FRAGMENTS
→ DARK PURPLE CORROSION STAIN.

石柱出现局部腐蚀与表层损伤，不整栋建筑崩塌。
摄影机短暂捕捉命中结果，再立即回到PYONA落地。
紫色损伤痕迹持续保留。

【00:20–00:25 — 紫色毒雾 / 侧后方真实急袭】

毒蟾从口部及身体两侧喷出短距离浓密紫色毒雾。
雾围绕毒蟾扩散，挡住PYONA的视线。

完全遮挡前，必须先看见：
POMIRA主动从毒蟾背上跃下，落向PYONA侧方。

她落地后沿地面快速绕向PYONA侧后方。
毒雾掩护移动，绝不是瞬移。
雾后短暂可见她的轮廓和实际脚步。

摄影机横向移动。
PYONA迅速转头寻找她。

POMIRA从侧后方毒雾中强硬切入。
右手掌缘包裹深紫色黏稠毒液，手刀直接攻击PYONA肩颈旁的防御线。

PYONA立即转身。
左前臂包裹旋转透明水膜，准确撞上POMIRA前臂与掌缘的进攻路径。

REAL FOREARM CONTACT
→ WATER AND VENOM COLLISION
→ BOTH ARMS RECOIL
→ BOTH CHARACTERS SHIFT THEIR FEET.

必须看清两人真实距离与接触。
禁止隔着一米只碰特效。

撞击把水膜染成紫色。
PYONA立即向外甩掉污染水，用右手强力拍开POMIRA的攻击线。
POMIRA借力后撤。

不长时间保持锁招。
两人迅速分开到约2米，直接准备最后一次正面交锋。

【00:25–00:30 — 水压掌 × 毒液掌 / 最终碰撞与认可】

00:25–00:27.5

两人同时向前爆发踏步。

PYONA右掌凝聚新的无色透明高压水。
POMIRA左掌包裹紧凑厚重的深紫色毒液。

双方肩、腰、髋同时推进。
是全身投入的真实掌击，不是原地伸手施法。

两掌在两人之间正面迎击。
掌前的清水与毒液先形成薄液体缓冲层，阻隔直接皮肤接触。
随后双方力量把液体界面猛烈压缩。

CLEAR OPPOSING PALM ATTACK
→ LIQUID BUFFER CONTACT
→ FULL BODY FORCE
→ PRESSURE COMPRESSION.

仅此处使用0.2秒micro slow motion：
透明清水与深紫色毒液沿碰撞界面卷曲。
接触区逐渐染紫，但两侧各自新释放的液体颜色仍清楚可辨。
液滴、黏液拉丝、衣料张力和双方收紧的表情同时可见。

TIME SNAP.

液体冲击向两侧和上方猛烈爆开。
不向两人脸部喷毒。
不是能量球，不是蓝紫激光。

两人被碰撞反冲同时推开约一米。
鞋底猛擦大理石，屈膝、收腹、重新稳住。
必须在碰撞爆发后才后退，禁止提前做受击反应。

00:27.5–00:30

两人仍抬手警戒，急促呼吸。
先确认对方都稳稳站住，再逐渐放松。

PYONA紧绷目光变成短促、服气的笑。
POMIRA微抬眉梢，也露出认可的笑。
不是突然卖萌、大笑或庆祝胜利。
她们认可对方刚刚展现的实力。

POMIRA收回一只手。
后方毒蟾迅速失去实体，沉降成深紫色黏稠液体。
召唤液体沿地面清晰回流到POMIRA掌下，被收回。
不出现第二只召唤兽，不使用漫长烟花式消失。

最终侧前方中景双人构图：
两人分别占据画面左右三分之一，互相看着对方。
头发与服装残留真实清水水滴。
远处石柱仍保留深紫色腐蚀痕迹。
地面保留战斗留下的水迹与少量毒液残留。

CUT AT EXACTLY 30 SECONDS.

【摄影与动作可读性】

高预算真人电影动作摄影。
三分法偏中心构图，留出攻击和移动方向的空间。

使用：
3/4 medium shot、
lateral tracking、
low-angle impact shot、
controlled handheld、
brief facial insert、
short crash zoom。

每个主要动作事件使用1–2个镜头。
攻击从开始到命中必须能读懂。
不要频繁碎切，不要疯狂摇晃，不要连续环绕人物。

突进用侧向跟拍。
召唤用低角度稍宽镜头建立体量。
拳、踢、前臂碰撞用中近景拍清接触。
最后对掌必须看清两人的位置、推进动作与液体碰撞界面。

禁止固定远景拍完整段落。
禁止长时间背后追拍。
禁止用景深虚化掉关键目标。
除最终碰撞的0.2秒外，其他动作保持快速正常速度。

ACTION READABILITY
> REAL CONTACT
> STRONG REACTION
> CHARACTER PERFORMANCE
> ELEMENTAL IMPACT
> CAMERA CHAOS.

【严格禁止】

禁止参考顺序或属性互换。
禁止额外真人、复制脸、换脸、人物身份混合。
禁止擅自修改参考图中的服装、发型、发色和配饰。

禁止任何绿色毒系效果。
毒刺、毒液、毒雾、毒蟾皮肤、毒性黏液、污染水与腐蚀痕迹全部采用紫色体系。
禁止把PYONA未受污染的清水也染成紫色。

禁止水变成冰、蓝色激光、固体玻璃或发光能量。
禁止毒液被清水自动净化。
禁止PYONA重新使用污染水。

禁止毒蟾没有重量或完全不受打击影响。
禁止POMIRA瞬移。
禁止攻击空气、目标错位、没有接触就自动后退或飞走。
禁止轻柔推挡、谨慎试探、慢动作连招、长时间蓄力。
禁止英雄Pose、研究手掌、欣赏特效或停下等待。

禁止血液、开放伤口、皮肤腐烂。
禁止台词、字幕、BGM、旁白、水印。

【核心目标】

严格30秒，清晰完成：

紫色毒刺连续发射与透明水弹精准截击
→ PYONA真实水压突进
→ 巨大紫色毒蟾实体化拦截
→ 重拳与旋转侧踢硬碰毒性皮肤
→ 高压水被捕获并转为紫色毒水反喷
→ 紫色毒雾掩护POMIRA真实侧后方急袭
→ 水压掌与毒液掌正面爆发碰撞
→ 双方稳住反冲，互相认可。

两人都主动、强硬、有威胁。
水与毒通过材质、运动和接触结果明确区分。
动作必须大胆、快速、猛烈，绝对不能谨慎。
最后的微笑来自真正势均力敌的精彩交锋。 Audio: dialogue and diegetic sound effects only, no background music

prompts.prompt:
Create ultra-realistic spontaneous vertical iPhone footage inside a lively Japanese summer festival during a bright, sunny afternoon.

Use the provided reference image ONLY as the identity reference for the main woman. Keep her facial identity, hairstyle, skin tone, proportions, and overall appearance perfectly consistent throughout the video.

The footage must feel like a real friend casually recording her during a vacation. Natural handheld camera shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus hunting, realistic exposure adaptation in strong daylight, authentic smartphone dynamic range, and genuine environmental audio. No staged acting.

0–3s

The woman walks through a crowded Japanese summer festival street under a bright blue sky, casually eating colorful kakigori (Japanese shaved ice). Colorful paper decorations, traditional festival stalls, and people in summer yukata fill the background. She notices something approaching from behind the crowd and slows down curiously.

3–6s

The camera quickly shifts over her shoulder, revealing a large group of traditional Japanese festival performers approaching with a portable mikoshi shrine decorated with colorful ornaments. The crowd parts naturally as the performers chant and move forward together. She widens her eyes in genuine surprise and instinctively steps aside.

6–9s

One cheerful performer notices her and briefly offers her a small traditional festival fan while continuing with the parade. She accepts it with a surprised laugh, looks at the camera as if sharing an unexpected moment with her friend, then turns back toward the procession.

9–12s

The performers pass very close to the camera, creating a brief, chaotic view of moving shoulders, colorful costumes, and the decorated shrine. The camera operator instinctively steps backward to avoid the crowd. Sunlight flickers naturally across the frame as people move past.

12–15s

The camera finds the woman again. She waves the fan excitedly, laughs, and takes a few quick steps to follow the parade. A festival visitor carrying a large colorful balloon briefly blocks the camera before the recording cuts off naturally.

Visual style: Bright natural midday sunlight, blue summer sky, colorful Japanese matsuri decorations, realistic skin pores, natural facial expressions, authentic crowd movement, ordinary vacation clothing and traditional yukata in the background, handheld iPhone footage, spontaneous travel memories.

Audio: Natural crowd chatter, festival drums, performers chanting in the distance, footsteps, and the woman's genuine laughter. No background music, no artificial sound effects, no scripted dialogue.

Avoid: Cinematic camera movements, slow motion, commercial advertising aesthetics, beauty filters, overacting, artificial facial expressions, duplicated people, distorted hands, floating objects, inconsistent character identity, changing clothes, unnatural crowd physics, oversaturated colors, and AI-generated visual artifacts.

16:9 | EXTREME LIVE-ACTION PHOTOREALISM | RAW DOCUMENTARY CINEMATIC REALISM. Natural lighting, realistic skin/hair/fabric/physics, authentic human performance, handheld cinematic camera. NO CGI, 3D, animation, fantasy, game look.

STRICT IDENTITY LOCK: Preserve the exact same male/female faces, hair, body proportions, age and identity from the previous video. NO face change, aging, beautification or character replacement.

FLASHBACK: The man and healthy woman happily chase each other through a beautiful green meadow, laughing naturally. He looks back teasingly while running. She catches him from behind and pulls him backward. He turns toward her.

SEAMLESS PRESENT → FLASHBACK COLLISION: At the exact moment he turns, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT. No camera cut or reposition. Keep identical perspective, height, framing and blocking. While he completes the turn, the green meadow gradually transforms into the devastated battlefield. Warm sunlight becomes cold. Green grass becomes dead yellow grass and rubble. The healthy woman seamlessly becomes the same terrifying zombie: tangled dirty hair, pale wounded skin, torn clothing. His clean black hoodie becomes his battle-damaged outfit.

ZOMBIE ATTACK: She suddenly lunges at him. He catches both arms and desperately holds her back. He recognizes her and becomes devastated. Tears fill his eyes. He screams in Indonesian:

“AAAHHH! KENAPA HARUS KAMU?! KENAPA KAMU?!”

She no longer recognizes him. He trembles, raises his firearm, looks into her face one last time and whispers:

“Istirahatlah dengan tenang...”

Brief pause. ONE realistic gunshot. She collapses. He lowers the weapon with no victory, only grief.

He kneels beside her, lifts her head onto his lap and gently strokes her tangled hair. His eyes fill with tears.

SOFT MEMORY RETURN: His hand continues the exact same movement. NO HARD CUT. The zombie gradually becomes the healthy woman again, wounds disappear, torn clothes become clean, ruined battlefield becomes the beautiful meadow, cold light becomes warm afternoon sunlight, his damaged outfit becomes the clean black hoodie. SAME POSE, SAME COMPOSITION.

CHOREOGRAPHY RHYTHM — the most important instruction: the fight plays in short sharp bursts separated by held beats, never as one continuous blur. Every strike lands as a distinct legible action with real weight and visible recoil. Keep the action spaced and readable rather than crowded.

SHOT 1 — 0.0s to 2.5s — CAMERA: medium, low angle, tracking hard laterally with them. INTENT: open mid-fight at full speed, and let the beauty of the setting land in the same frame as the violence.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.5s to 5.0s — CAMERA: close, low angle, locked off, shaking on impact. INTENT: one clean readable exchange so the fight has weight before it gets faster.
He comes in heavy and throws a hook. She catches it forearm to forearm with a hard slap of contact, steps inside, and drives an elbow up into his jaw. His head snaps sideways into the light.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 — 5.0s to 7.5s — CAMERA: wide, tracking hard with them, whipping. INTENT: consequence — the setting takes the damage, which is half the point.
He shoves her backward along the marble bar counter. Glassware sweeps off it and shatters across the stone floor in a long spray, a planter goes over, and she rolls off the counter and comes straight back at him.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.5s to 10.0s — CAMERA: locked to her, wide-angle, moving with her. INTENT: the turn — she stops defending and starts pressing.
She walks him down across the terrace landing three strikes in sequence: a straight right, a hook to the body that folds him, and a knee driven up into his ribs. They crash through a white linen table on the way, plates and cloth going everywhere. His guard drops lower each time.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 5 — 10.0s to 12.5s — CAMERA: close, low angle, locked off. INTENT: the last exchange, given room so it reads clean.
He swings one desperate wild hook. She ducks under it and comes up planting her whole body weight into a final overhand right across his jaw. Hard impact, dust and pollen bursting through the sunlight around them.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 — 12.5s to 15.0s — CAMERA: low angle, locked off, very slow push-in. INTENT: end on her still standing, with the wrecked terrace and the sunset behind her.
He drops to his hands and knees on the pale stone among the broken glass and stays there. She backs off two steps, chest heaving, hair fully loose now, hands still half up. She lowers them slowly, the low sun burning behind her and the city hazed out beyond the balustrade. The frame holds.

プロフィール画面に表示されている既存の文字、表示名、ユーザー名、自己紹介、リンク、日付、フォロー数、フォロワー数、ボタン、認証バッジ、アイコン、固定投稿、ステータスバー、ナビゲーションの内容と位置を最後まで変化させない。

既存の文字を再生成、書き換え、翻訳、変形させない。画面をスクロールしない。

ヘッダー画像内の人物は静止画のまま。動き出すのは円形プロフィールアイコン内の女の子一人だけ。

【キャラクター固定】

円形アイコンの女の子本人。

白いキャップ、茶色のボブからミディアムヘア、大きな茶色の瞳、ゆったりしたグレーのパーカー、黒いショートパンツ、白いソックス、白いスニーカー。赤いリンゴを一つ持っている。

顔、髪型、髪色、帽子、衣装、配色、線、塗り、柔らかな2Dイラストの質感をアイコンから変えない。

実写化、3D化、別人化、衣装変更、過度なデフォルメは禁止。

外へ出たときも小さな全身キャラクターとして、手足の長さと関節を自然に維持する。キャラクターを複製しない。アイコンの中と外へ同時に二人存在させない。

【季節と装飾】

季節は日本の初秋。

金木犀、淡いピンクの秋桜、すすき、山吹色の銀杏、小さなどんぐり、赤いリンゴ、琥珀色の落ち葉を使う。

山吹色、琥珀色、橙色、くすみ赤、淡い桃色を中心とした、温かく可愛い手描きの飾り。

春の桜、夏の花火、雪、クリスマス、ハロウィンなど、別の季節や行事のモチーフは混ぜない。

飾りはヘッダー下端、アイコンの外周、画面四隅、文字のない余白へ控えめに配置する。既存の文字、数値、顔、ボタン、投稿を覆わない。

【カメラと空間】

カメラはプロフィール画面の真正面に完全固定。

ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、揺れ、スクロール、カット、画面転換なし。

プロフィール画面を立体的なスマートフォンへ変換せず、画面自体を一枚の平面として維持する。スマートフォン本体、手、指、机、周囲の風景は映さない。

キャラクターだけが画面の平面上を歩き、装飾を取り付ける。

【時間構成】

0.0–3.0秒：

プロフィール画面は完全に静止している。

円形アイコンの女の子が一度ゆっくり瞬きをして、アイコンの外を見回す。アイコンの縁に、暖かな琥珀色の光が細く走る。

女の子は持っている赤いリンゴをいったんアイコンの縁へ置き、両手を縁にかける。右脚、左脚の順にアイコンから外へ出し、身体を持ち上げて、アイコン右側の広い白い余白へ軽く着地する。

身体はアイコン内の大きさから、画面の高さの約18％ほどの小さな全身サイズへ滑らかに変化する。カットや瞬間移動は使わない。

女の子が外へ出たあとのアイコン内は、人物のいない元の黄色い背景になる。分身は残さない。

3.0–8.0秒：

女の子はアイコンの縁に置いたリンゴを拾い、白い余白を右へ二歩進む。

左足で止まり、身体を軽くひねりながら、リンゴを持った右手を左下から右上へ大きく振る。

その手とリンゴの軌道に正確に追従して、細い琥珀色の光のリボンが伸びる。光が通過した場所にだけ、金木犀、銀杏、すすきで作られた細い秋のガーランドが、ヘッダー画像の下端へ順番に取り付けられる。

装飾が先に突然出現してはいけない。腕の動き、光の軌道、飾りの出現を完全に連動させる。

動作に合わせて髪、キャップのつば、パーカーの裾が小さく遅れて揺れる。

8.0–12.0秒：

女の子はアイコンの横へ戻り、片膝をつく。

左手の指先でアイコンの外周を半円状になぞると、その指先を追って秋桜、どんぐり、小さな葉、平面的なリンゴの飾りが一つずつ並び、控えめな秋のリースになる。

続けて両手を画面の左右へ開く。数枚の琥珀色の落ち葉が左右の余白へ舞い、軽く回転しながら減速して、それぞれ安全な余白へ着地する。

葉には適度な慣性と空気抵抗を与える。文字やボタンの上には着地させない。

女の子が持つ実物の赤いリンゴは一つだけ。装飾のリンゴは小さな平面モチーフとして明確に区別する。

12.0–15.0秒：

女の子は完成した飾りを左右に見渡し、満足そうに小さくうなずく。

リンゴを胸元へ抱え、アイコンへ向かって二歩走り、縁へ片手をついて軽く跳び込む。身体は連続的に小さくなりながら、元の円形アイコンの中へ戻る。

14.2秒までに、アイコンは@Image 1と同じ、赤いリンゴを持った元の構図へ完全に復帰する。

女の子がアイコンの中から一度だけ可愛くウインクする。最後に銀杏の葉が一枚だけゆっくり降り、右上の文字のない余白へ着地する。

最終0.5秒は動きを落ち着かせ、秋の飾り付けが完成したプロフィール画面を見せる。

【音】

セリフ、ナレーション、歌、字幕、背景音楽なし。

アイコンから出る瞬間に小さな紙の「ふわっ」という音。

飾りが取り付けられるたびに、柔らかな葉擦れと小さなステッカー音。

アイコンへ戻ってウインクする瞬間に、透明感のある短いベル音を一度だけ鳴らす。

音は必ず画面内の動作と同期させる。

【最終状態】

既存のプロフィール画面とすべての文字情報は@Image 1のまま。

女の子は円形アイコンへ戻り、分身は存在しない。

初秋の装飾だけが、既存情報を邪魔しない余白へ美しく残っている。

新しい文字、ロゴ、字幕、透かしを追加しない。

Style: Hyper-realistic, nostalgic Japanese school home video recorded on an early-2000s consumer digital camcorder.

CORE CONCEPT

A Japanese high school girl spending an ordinary school day, casually recorded by her closest friend. Nothing is staged. Her expressions and movements are natural, quiet, and spontaneous. The video should feel like a real memory recovered years later.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

The same Japanese high school girl throughout all six scenes. Friendly, approachable face, realistic skin texture, short black bob haircut with a small silver hairpin above her right ear. White short-sleeved school shirt, maroon ribbon, gray pleated skirt, white socks, and indoor school slippers. Outside school, she wears simple white sneakers and carries the same navy school bag.

Maintain identical facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, uniform, and belongings in every scene.

TIMED SCRIPT

SCENE 1 — 0:00–0:03 | Morning Classroom

A lived-in Japanese public high school classroom in soft morning sunlight. The girl enters carrying her navy school bag, notices her friend recording, and gives a small sleepy smile. She places her bag beside her desk and sits down naturally.

Camera: Handheld medium shot, slightly imperfect framing, gentle natural shake.

HARD CUT.

SCENE 2 — 0:03–0:06 | Window-Side Desk

She sits beside the classroom window and opens her notebook. A light breeze gently lifts one page. She presses it down with her fingers, glances toward the camera, and smiles softly before looking back at her notebook.

Camera: Casual handheld framing from the neighboring desk. Natural window light and realistic paper movement.

HARD CUT.

SCENE 3 — 0:06–0:09 | Lunch Break

In the school courtyard, she sits on a simple bench holding a sandwich wrapped in paper. She takes a bite, notices the camera, and playfully offers the sandwich toward her friend. Her eyes narrow naturally as she smiles.

Camera: Medium-wide home-video shot. A few students and green trees remain softly visible in the background.

HARD CUT.

SCENE 4 — 0:09–0:12 | School Corridor

She walks down a quiet school corridor with her school bag over one shoulder. Someone behind the camera says something indistinct. She turns her head, laughs naturally for a moment, then continues walking. The camera adjusts slightly to keep her in frame.

Camera: Handheld follow shot at normal walking speed. No stabilization or dramatic movement.

HARD CUT.

SCENE 5 — 0:12–0:15 | The Last Moments in Class

The classroom is almost empty after school. Warm late-afternoon sunlight falls across the desks. She stands beside her window-side desk, rests one hand on its edge, and quietly looks outside at the trees. She turns toward the camera and gives a gentle, unposed smile.

Camera: Mostly stationary handheld medium shot with slight natural movement.

HARD CUT.

SCENE 6 — 0:15–0:20 | Walking Home

Outside the school gate, she walks away along a quiet Japanese residential street in soft golden evening light. The camera follows a few steps behind. She notices her friend has slowed down, turns around, and gives a small, genuine wave with a warm smile. She turns back and continues walking until she moves toward the far end of the street.

The camera stops following and remains pointed at the quiet street for one extra moment. We hear her fading footsteps, a few birds, and a gentle breeze. The recording abruptly cuts off at exactly 20 seconds without a fade.

CAMERA AND VISUAL STYLE

Early-2000s consumer digital camcorder footage. Slight handheld shake, imperfect framing, mild autofocus adjustments, subtle digital noise, slightly soft image details, muted colors, imperfect white balance, and natural exposure fluctuations.

Natural available light only. Realistic skin pores, individual hair strands, and natural facial expressions. Ordinary Japanese school architecture and authentic background activity.

24–30 SECONDS — THE OUTBREAK SPREADS: The train crosses an elevated railway bridge overlooking a large urban intersection. Abandoned vehicles block the road, smoke rises from a damaged building, and crowds of civilians flee as a mass of infected people pours through the streets. Briefly include the tiny fluffy puppy in the lower-right foreground, sitting close to the woman and looking toward the window with alert ears. Keep the exterior disaster sharply dominant. As the train passes beneath a darker concrete structure, an infected figure suddenly appears in a gap between the supports before vanishing from view. PUPPY REALISM: The puppy must remain a small, fluffy, anatomically correct real dog throughout the video. Preserve its cream-and-white coat, tiny body, dark eyes, and natural proportions. Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second, 16:9 psychedelic horror music video: 30 distinct animated compositions, an average of 0.5 seconds per shot. Start at full intensity on the first frame. Make the supplied artworks come violently alive inside a corrupted, hypnotic nightmare.

REFERENCE DIRECTION
Use all supplied images as visual references. Preserve their recognizable silhouettes, intricate ornament, chrome surfaces, skulls, horns, jeweled details, printed textures, deep blacks, blood-red accents and electric rainbow colors. Develop additional compositions from these motifs to reach 30 shots. Preserve the mix of photographic detail and graphic illustration. Each shot fills the screen.
MOTION PRIORITY
The subjects themselves must move, not just the camera. Use one dominant, instantly readable action per shot:

Horned figures snap their heads toward the viewer; metallic blindfolds ripple and ribbons whip outward.
Chrome mouths open abruptly; keys twist, chains swing and skull-shaped jewelry vibrates.

Uncanny deer jerk forward; antlers branch rapidly and nearby plants coil inward.
Skeletal warriors slash across the frame; armor plates shift and radial patterns spin behind them.
A psychedelic mechanical tunnel contracts and pulls the camera through its center.
Giant cybernetic skulls loom over a neon city; jaw mechanisms snap and buildings bend around them.
Chrome bird-skull creatures thrust their beaks toward the lens; segmented necks coil and unfold.
A skeletal astronaut snaps toward camera as neon vapor pours through the helmet.
Striped cakes twist like living sculptures; cream stretches, cherries levitate and red syrup flows upward.
Horned skull idols rotate abruptly; ornaments orbit their faces and printed layers slip out of registration.
An ornate oiran-like figure turns sharply; hair ornaments vibrate, sleeves whip and metallic ribs expand.
A jeweled black cat fixes its gaze on the viewer, then lunges toward the lens as its ornaments scatter into light.
Use different actions and framing when a motif returns. Make every scene visibly animate from its first frame. Keep the main subject recognizable beneath the distortion.
EDITING / 15-SECOND STRUCTURE
0.0-3.0s: 5 shots, approximately 0.6s each. Open with an extreme close-up of a horned face snapping toward camera on the first kick. Cut through a metallic mouth, a deer, a skeletal warrior and a tunnel. Immediate impact; no intro.
3.0-6.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Neon city skulls, chrome bird creatures, astronaut and cat. Hard cuts, whip-pan transitions and sudden changes of scale.
6.0-9.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Warping desserts, horned idols and the ornate figure. Surfaces stretch, liquefy and snap back. Push through an eye, mouth or spiral into the next composition.
9.0-12.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Return to earlier motifs with more aggressive actions, extreme close-ups, inverted viewpoints and brief kaleidoscopic multiplication.
12.0-15.0s: 7 shots: six approximately 0.4s shots followed by a 0.6s final shot. Maximum kinetic intensity. End with a horned skull rushing into the lens, the image tearing into chromatic fragments, then an abrupt cut to black on the final distorted impact. No fade.

GLITCH / NOISE
Dense, deliberate analog and digital corruption: RGB channel separation, horizontal scanline tears, VHS tracking errors, CRT interference, granular static, datamosh trails, pixel-sorting streaks, block displacement, color inversion, frame skipping and short motion echoes. Place strong glitches on cuts, kicks and snare fills. Use brief 1-3-frame disruptions and textured noise bursts while keeping the subjects visible. Distortion must react to moving forms. Alternate crisp, disturbing detail with explosive corruption. Avoid prolonged full-screen white flashes.

CAMERA
Aggressive crash zooms, rapid lateral whip pans, short barrel rolls, macro-to-wide jumps and forward dives through openings. Choose one main camera move per shot. Preserve clear focal points and deep layered motion.
AUDIO
Original instrumental EDM / dark psychedelic trance at 150 BPM. Start immediately with a heavy four-on-the-floor kick and tight rolling sixteenth-note bass. Add distorted acid arpeggios, unsettling resonant synths, metallic percussion, reverse swells and granular digital noise. Synchronize cuts, subject impacts and glitches to beats and offbeats. Increase density toward the final second. No vocals, speech or narration.
AVOID
Static slideshow frames, simple Ken Burns motion, slow motion, gentle crossfades, long establishing shots, cute cheerful mood, generic smooth plastic rendering, persistent split screens, contact-sheet layouts, added captions, titles, subtitles, logos and watermarks.
