Style: Hyper-realistic 1980s romantic soap opera. Everything looks like a premium 1980s television drama: soft diffusion filters, warm golden lighting, subtle film grain, dramatic close-ups, gentle camera zooms, emotional acting, glamorous costumes, rich color grading, elegant cinematography and classic soap-opera pacing. No cartoon, no CGI, no 3D appearance. Characters must exactly match the provided reference sheets.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

Adrian:

• 20-year-old athletic man

• Dark tousled hair

• Blue eyes

• White fitted T-shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers

• Charismatic but emotionally guarded

Evelyn:

• Elegant brunette

• Soft bob haircut

• Polka-dot blouse, red pleated skirt

• Pearl necklace

• Intelligent, graceful, emotionally reserved

SETTING

A beautiful small-town street during golden sunset. Palm trees sway gently, vintage cars pass slowly, neon motel signs begin glowing, warm summer breeze, unmistakable 1980s atmosphere.

[00:00–00:05]

Wide cinematic establishing shot.

Adrian leans against his vintage convertible outside an old café, absentmindedly spinning his car keys. He notices Evelyn walking down the sidewalk carrying a notebook. Time almost seems to slow. Soft breeze moves her hair as she glances toward him. Close-ups alternate between Adrian's captivated eyes and Evelyn's shy smile.

[00:05–00:10]

Medium tracking shot.

Evelyn accidentally drops her notebook. Loose handwritten pages scatter across the street. Adrian immediately rushes over to help. They kneel together gathering the papers. Their hands reach for the same page and gently touch. They both freeze for a moment, exchanging an awkward but genuine smile.

[00:10–00:15]

Close-up sequence.

Adrian stands and hands the notebook back to Evelyn. She thanks him softly. They lock eyes for several long seconds. The surrounding street noise fades beneath the emotional moment. A slow push-in captures subtle smiles, nervous breathing and growing attraction.

[00:15–00:20]

A sudden summer rain begins. People hurry away, but neither of them moves. Adrian removes his leather jacket and carefully drapes it over Evelyn's shoulders. She looks deeply touched. Close-up of their eyes meeting again as raindrops glisten on their faces.

[00:20–00:25]

Wide romantic shot.

They walk side by side beneath glowing neon signs and vintage storefronts, sharing quiet conversation and occasional laughter. Camera circles around them while the rain slows into a gentle drizzle. Evelyn looks at Adrian with growing affection. Adrian steals another glance at her, smiling.

[00:25–00:30]

They stop beneath an old cinema marquee illuminated with warm lights. Silence. Adrian slowly reaches for Evelyn's hand. She accepts without hesitation. They stand together, smiling softly, as the camera slowly cranes upward, revealing the glowing street below while they continue looking into each other's eyes, hopeful about their future.

Audio:

Classic 1980s romantic soap-opera soundtrack with warm synthesizers, soft piano, gentle saxophone, light rain ambience, distant traffic, footsteps on wet pavement, subtle city ambience and emotional silence during intimate moments.

Camera:

Frequent close-ups, slow push-ins, over-the-shoulder conversations, elegant tracking shots, gentle crane movement, emotional reaction shots, cinematic wides and soft-focus glamour close-ups reminiscent of iconic 1980s television romances.

Negative:

No action, no comedy, no modern technology, no smartphones, no CGI, no animation, no exaggerated acting, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.prompt:
THE NAMELESS EDGE
High-Adrenaline Dark Fantasy — Cinematic Movie Trailer

[VISUAL STYLE LOCK]

Ultra-realistic, premium live-action, epic dark fantasy movie trailer.

A lost 1960s–1970s sword-and-sorcery masterpiece, reimagined with the extraordinary scale, detail and realism of modern prestige cinema.

A world of ancient sorcery, decadent empires, cursed weapons, crumbling civilizations, terrifying supernatural entities, forgotten gods, black iron, bronze armor, ruined palaces, immense stone temples, violent medieval warfare, and cosmic horror.

The atmosphere is tragic, savage, mysterious, melancholic and overwhelming.

CINEMATOGRAPHY LOCK

Shot on ARRI Alexa XT with Camtec Vintage Ultra Prime lenses. 35mm Kodak film aesthetic.

Hazy, low-contrast cinematography. Muted earthy colors. Heavy analog film grain. Mild chromatic aberration. Slight lens vignette. Soft highlight bloom. Organic optical imperfections.

Indie-cinematic framing with large negative space, off-center compositions, naturalistic blocking, dramatic silhouettes and unusually deep environmental compositions.

Aggressive rack-focus transitions, handheld documentary-style camera movement, sudden whip-pans, imperfect crash zooms, violent camera vibration, rapid low-angle tracking shots, shaky shoulder-mounted combat photography.

Naturalistic lighting, practical fire, pale moonlight, thick atmospheric fog, volumetric smoke, heavy rain, blowing ash, realistic dust, layered focus and physical debris.

The production should feel like an authentic, enormously expensive historical fantasy epic with practical locations, colossal physical sets, realistic costumes, tangible weapons, massive armies and convincing old-school creature effects.

No glossy videogame rendering, cartoon physics, superhero aesthetics, modern tactical costumes, futuristic technology or polished digital magic.

Magic should look frightening, unnatural, ancient and physically integrated with the real world.

MUSIC AND EDITING LOCK

Use @Video 1 as the exact musical track.

Create an EXTREMELY HIGH-ADRENALINE, HIGH-PACING cinematic trailer.

Cut tightly to the actual percussion, musical accents, instrumental transitions, rhythmic subdivisions and climactic impacts of the soundtrack.

Use violent hard cuts on heavy beats, rapid 3–6-shot montages during faster passages, and unexpected half-second moments of silence or visual stillness before the largest musical explosions.

Every important beat should correspond to a sword impact, bodily movement, explosion, camera transition, supernatural event or dramatic reveal.

Dynamic action match-cuts between locations. Weapons, arrows, falling objects, smoke, flowing cloaks and flying debris can bridge consecutive shots.

The editing should build in intensity until the final sequence becomes an overwhelming collision of medieval war, supernatural terror and personal tragedy.

No narration or spoken dialogue is necessary.

ORIGINAL WORLD AND CHARACTER LOCK

The setting is a fictional dying continent where ancient kingdoms survive among the colossal fossilized remains of creatures that once ruled the oceans.

An expanding religious military empire conquers the continent using armies, massive siege engines and enormous ritual bells that can alter the physical world.

The protagonist is SAREN, a lean, battle-scarred former imperial war-scribe turned exile, in his late thirties. Weathered olive skin, short dark hair with a single premature gray streak, tired gray-green eyes, an old scar cutting across the bridge of his nose, and an exhausted, haunted expression.

He wears tarnished bronze scale armor, weather-beaten black leather, layered dark cloth and a faded deep-red traveling cloak.

He is not a conventional heroic warrior. His strength comes from desperation, experience and a supernatural weapon he fears.

His weapon is THE NAMELESS EDGE.

A massive, ancient, charcoal-colored sword forged from the metal of a shattered ceremonial bell.

Its blade is broad and uneven, marked by strange concentric engravings and fine golden fractures within the dark iron.

The sword is sentient but never speaks in human language.

When drawn, it emits an almost inaudible metallic toll that causes nearby flames to flicker and loose objects to tremble.

Every time Saren uses its supernatural strength, the sword consumes one of HIS OWN memories.

The greater the violence, the more important the memory it takes.

His victories gradually erase his identity.

His closest companion is IVA, an itinerant astronomer and battlefield healer who carries a collection of small engraved bronze tokens. Each token records a memory Saren has already lost.

The antagonist is THE CHOIR MARSHAL, the masked commander of a religious empire whose soldiers march beneath enormous mobile bell towers.

These figures, their appearances, relationships, history and supernatural mechanics are entirely original.

THE TRAILER

BLACK.

An immense metallic object vibrates in darkness.

A thin crack travels across its surface.

The camera pulls backward.

It is an ancient BRONZE BELL.

Half buried in black sand.

Its broken surface is covered in forgotten inscriptions.

One enormous fracture splits the metal from top to bottom.

A pale human hand enters frame.

Fingers touch the crack.

The first musical impact.

HARD CUT.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP.

A weathered man's eye opens.

SAREN.

His face is covered in dust and dried blood.

A violent explosion illuminates his features.

He turns.

The camera rack-focuses past his face.

Behind him, an enormous ancient city is burning.

THE CITY OF VARN.

An impossible settlement built among the colossal fossilized ribs of a prehistoric sea creature.

Black stone towers rise between enormous white bones.

Suspended bridges connect crooked palaces.

Huge bronze bells hang from monumental archways.

Armies pour through its breached gates.

The music accelerates.

HARD CUT.

A cavalry rider charges directly toward camera.

CUT.

Horse hooves strike wet black mud.

CUT.

A bronze-armored soldier raises an executioner's axe.

CUT.

Saren pulls his enormous charcoal-black sword from its scabbard.

The metal produces a deep, unnatural vibration.

CUT ON THE BEAT.

The axe comes down.

Saren catches the strike with the flat of his blade.

METAL EXPLODES INTO SPARKS.

The handheld camera violently recoils.

Saren twists and drives his shoulder into the attacker.

The soldier stumbles backward.

Saren swings the blade.

A tremendous impact.

The soldier falls.

For an instant the battle continues normally.

Then—

An enormous bronze bell somewhere above the battlefield begins shaking.

Its clapper is completely motionless.

A strange ripple passes through the air.

The sword's golden fractures glow faintly.

Saren gasps.

A MEMORY FLASH.

A young child laughing in sunlight.

A wooden house overlooking green fields.

A woman's hand closing around his.

The images become violently fragmented.

Then DISAPPEAR.

Saren staggers.

He looks at a small portrait tied to his wrist.

The expression on his face changes.

He no longer recognizes the person depicted.

THE MUSIC STRIKES HARDER.

A violent whip-pan follows Saren as he turns toward another attacker.

CUT.

An imperial cavalry formation charges through a narrow canyon.

CUT.

Massive siege wheels crush abandoned wagons.

CUT.

A city gate disintegrates beneath a giant bronze battering ram.

CUT.

An armored soldier is hurled across a courtyard.

CUT.

A blade scrapes violently along a stone wall.

CUT.

Saren runs through a collapsing hallway.

Burning beams crash behind him.

The camera retreats backward at full speed, struggling to hold focus on his face.

He jumps over a fallen column.

A shower of sparks crosses the lens.

MATCH CUT.

The sparks become STARS.

A vast desert at night.

IVA stands atop a ruined astronomical observatory.

She is a young woman with wind-tangled black hair, weathered traveling clothes, faded blue robes beneath light leather armor, and a collection of small bronze memory tokens hanging from her belt.

She looks upward.

The stars begin moving.

Not across the sky.

TOWARD EACH OTHER.

Entire constellations twist into unfamiliar patterns.

Iva raises a brass astronomical instrument.

The instrument suddenly CRACKS.

A low metallic vibration travels across the desert.

The camera whip-pans toward the horizon.

An immense line of IMPERIAL BELL TOWERS is crossing the dunes.

Thousands of soldiers march beneath them.

Each siege tower carries a different enormous bronze bell.

The bells begin swinging.

None produces an audible sound.

But the dunes tremble.

The sky visibly darkens.

CUT ON THE NEXT BEAT.

THE CHOIR MARSHAL stands inside a gigantic ritual chamber.

A towering figure in dark bronze armor, a weathered ceremonial cloak and a smooth, elongated metal mask shaped like an abstract funerary face.

Behind him hang hundreds of small bells.

He raises his left hand.

Every bell stops moving.

He closes his fist.

A stone column across the chamber instantly SHATTERS.

The camera is struck by dust and falling fragments.

SMASH CUT.

Saren is running across a narrow bridge above a tremendous underground abyss.

Imperial soldiers pursue him.

The handheld camera races alongside.

A spear strikes the stone beside his foot.

He turns.

Swings his sword.

The bridge's supporting chain breaks.

Its huge iron links explode outward.

The bridge begins falling.

Saren leaps.

The camera leaps with him.

The bridge disintegrates behind them.

They FALL INTO DARKNESS.

The soundtrack enters a rapid sequence of beats.

The fall transforms into a violent MONTAGE.

A gigantic stone idol opening its sealed eyes.

A black-armored knight emerging from a burning doorway.

A woman's hand pressing an engraved bronze token into another hand.

An enormous desert creature dragging its armored body beneath the sand.

A line of imperial archers releasing hundreds of arrows simultaneously.

An ancient king's crown sinking into black water.

A chained prisoner screaming inside a chamber full of bells.

A temple ceiling collapsing as enormous stone figures move behind it.

A pale eclipse appearing above a battlefield.

A rusted sword thrust upward through thick mist.

A hundred horses rearing at exactly the same moment.

A monstrous stone face splitting open from within.

A close-up of THE NAMELESS EDGE.

Its golden fractures pulse.

The metallic vibration becomes almost unbearable.

HARD CUT.

Saren lands heavily on the floor of an ancient subterranean hall.

His knees buckle.

The camera drops with him.

Dust erupts from the impact.

He looks upward.

An enormous underground architecture stretches into darkness.

Gigantic fossilized bones form the vaults.

Ancient bronze mechanisms hang from chains hundreds of feet long.

At the center of the chamber is a colossal suspended bell, cracked and blackened by age.

Directly beneath it lies an altar.

Around the altar stand dozens of ancient suits of ceremonial armor.

EMPTY.

Their helmets slowly turn toward Saren.

All at once.

The music reaches another explosion.

THE ARMORS BEGIN MOVING.

A bronze sword strikes the floor beside Saren.

He rolls aside.

A second armored figure attacks.

He deflects the strike.

A third comes from behind.

Saren ducks.

The blade cuts through an ancient chain.

The chain whips across camera.

CUT.

EXT. DESERT — DAY.

An enormous iron chain snaps beneath the weight of a siege engine.

The machine tilts.

Its gigantic wheels buckle.

Soldiers scatter.

The entire structure tips sideways and crashes into the sand.

The impact sends a wall of dust toward camera.

CUT.

Saren and Iva run through the dust storm.

Behind them, an imperial army emerges in silhouette.

Iva looks backward.

An enormous figure rises through the dunes.

A SIX-LEGGED DESERT LEVIATHAN.

Its skin resembles cracked stone, covered in layers of rough mineral plates.

It has a wide, eyeless skull, enormous grinding jaws and a body scarred by centuries of desert erosion.

Its movements are heavy and animalistic.

Sand cascades from its shoulders.

It lowers its head.

A tremendous bellow shakes the landscape.

Imperial horses panic.

The creature charges through the army.

Armored bodies and wooden siege structures are thrown aside.

The camera runs at ground level between fleeing soldiers.

A soldier falls directly in front of the lens.

The camera stumbles.

A massive claw crashes into the earth.

CUT ON IMPACT.

Saren is thrown against a stone wall.

He falls to his knees.

Three imperial soldiers surround him.

He raises the sword.

A deep metallic vibration.

The weapon's golden fractures brighten.

The soldiers hesitate.

Saren begins moving with sudden, unnatural strength.

He strikes.

One shield breaks.

He pivots.

A spear is deflected.

A second soldier falls.

The camera circles him rapidly, imperfectly, staying close enough to feel the weight of every movement.

He delivers one final devastating blow.

A violent wave of displaced air erupts outward.

The surrounding soldiers are knocked backward.

Dust rises.

Saren stands motionless.

The sword vibrates in his hand.

Another memory is taken.

FLASH.

Iva smiling beside a campfire.

FLASH.

Iva bandaging his wounded shoulder.

FLASH.

Iva asleep during a long journey.

The images tear apart and disappear.

Saren looks at Iva.

She moves toward him.

He raises the sword defensively.

He DOES NOT RECOGNIZE HER.

The camera abruptly rack-focuses from his confused eyes to her devastated expression.

For half a second—

The music gives them space.

Iva reaches into her coat.

She takes out a small bronze token.

Engraved upon it is the image of two figures standing beneath a constellation.

She places it in Saren's empty hand.

His fingers close around it.

He stares at the engraving.

Then—

A distant bell TOLLS.

The music erupts into its MAIN CLIMAX.

HARD CUT.

A MASSIVE ARMY CHARGES DOWN A MOUNTAINSIDE.

Thousands of soldiers carrying black banners descend toward an ancient fortress.

CUT.

An enormous wooden siege tower catches fire.

CUT.

A giant stone statue falls from a temple roof.

CUT.

Imperial cavalry gallops through burning wheat fields.

CUT.

A monstrous desert leviathan bursts from the ground beneath a war machine.

CUT.

The Choir Marshal raises both arms beneath a gigantic bronze bell.

CUT.

Saren races up a staircase while the steps collapse behind him.

CUT.

Iva jumps from a crumbling balcony.

CUT.

Saren catches her with his free hand.

CUT.

A spear flashes across camera.

CUT.

Saren pulls Iva into a doorway just as the surrounding wall explodes.

CUT.

A tremendous storm forms above the city.

Enormous clouds twist around a black circular opening.

Ancient bells begin ringing throughout the continent.

Their sound is not heard.

Instead, the world physically REACTS.

Water rises from wells.

Dust moves upward.

Flames shrink into themselves.

Stone faces fracture.

Horses freeze in place.

A gigantic crack appears in the desert.

The camera whip-pans toward a fortress on the horizon.

ITS ENTIRE CENTRAL TOWER COLLAPSES.

CUT.

Saren stands on a high battlement overlooking the battle.

His sword hangs loosely in his right hand.

Far below, thousands of civilians flee through the gates of the city.

The imperial army closes in.

Iva reaches the battlement behind him.

She tries to grab his arm.

Saren looks toward her.

He recognizes the bronze token at her neck.

But not her face.

A tremendous dark cloud covers the sun.

Saren looks down at THE NAMELESS EDGE.

The sword trembles.

He knows what it wants.

He grips the weapon with both hands.

THE FINAL ASSAULT BEGINS.

Saren runs toward the edge of the battlement.

The camera accelerates beside him.

He leaps from the wall onto a collapsing siege platform.

The wooden structure breaks under his weight.

He rolls.

Rises.

Three enemies rush him.

The editing becomes brutally fast.

ONE BEAT — a sword strike.

NEXT BEAT — sparks across frame.

NEXT BEAT — an enemy shield breaks.

NEXT BEAT — Saren spins beneath a spear.

NEXT BEAT — his sword smashes against a helmet.

NEXT BEAT — a soldier falls backward into smoke.

NEXT BEAT — the camera crashes through the smoke with him.

Inside the smoke—

AN IMPOSSIBLE VISION.

Saren stands alone on an endless plain covered in shallow water.

A thousand enormous bells hang motionless in the black sky.

Beneath each bell stands a different version of Saren.

A child.

A soldier.

A prisoner.

An old man.

A stranger.

Every figure turns to look at him.

One by one, they disappear.

Each disappearance synchronized with a musical impact.

The water beneath Saren becomes BLACK.

He looks down.

His reflection has NO FACE.

SMASH CUT.

BACK TO THE BATTLEFIELD.

Saren screams and charges forward.

The sword's golden fractures erupt with pale light.

The ground splits beneath the enemy formation.

A massive shock wave throws soldiers and siege engines into the air.

The great imperial bells begin shattering.

One after another.

Each bell detonates on a separate musical beat.

Bronze fragments fill the sky.

The Choir Marshal stands beneath the final bell.

His smooth metal mask begins splitting.

A deep crack divides it vertically.

Inside the mask—

ABSOLUTE DARKNESS.

The final bell falls.

Its immense body crashes into the city.

The explosion sends an enormous circular wall of dust across the battlefield.

The camera retreats directly in front of Saren as the shock wave approaches.

He continues walking toward us.

His cloak tears in the wind.

His face is bloodied.

His armor is broken.

His sword has begun to crumble.

Iva runs toward him through the smoke.

The music reaches the FINAL RAPID IMPACTS.

CUT.

A collapsing throne of bronze and stone.

CUT.

A thousand imperial banners burning.

CUT.

An enormous shadow crossing the desert.

CUT.

The black sword fracturing from tip to hilt.

CUT.

A screaming mouth behind a cracked ceremonial mask.

CUT.

An ancient city swallowed by a wall of sand.

CUT.

The last bell shattering in midair.

CUT.

Saren falling to one knee.

CUT.

A bronze memory token tumbling through the air.

CUT.

Iva reaching toward him.

CUT.

The sword's final golden fracture going DARK.

For the last image—

A tight, trembling handheld close-up.

Saren is sitting among the ruins of the battlefield.

His sword lies broken beside him.

Iva kneels in front of him.

Her eyes are filled with tears.

She takes his hand.

He looks at her with the confused innocence of someone meeting a stranger.

She turns his palm upward.

Inside it lies the bronze token showing two figures beneath a constellation.

Saren studies the engraving.

He looks from the token to her face.

He opens his mouth.

He cannot remember her name.

The camera slowly rack-focuses away from their faces toward the broken sword lying in the foreground.

Even shattered, the weapon begins to VIBRATE.

A tiny golden fracture lights up.

THE FINAL MUSICAL IMPACT.

BLACK.

A stark title appears in tarnished silver lettering, surrounded by deep shadow and faint drifting ash.

THE NAMELESS EDGE

A final, distant metallic vibration.

Silence.

[FINAL PRODUCTION LOCK]

This is a fully original dark-fantasy film concept, not an adaptation or recreation of any existing fantasy franchise.

Maintain the atmosphere of vintage sword-and-sorcery paperback cover art, 1960s–1970s occult cinema, theatrical practical effects and grand historical adventure filmmaking.

Everything should feel discovered, ancient, physical and dangerous.

Make the cursed sword compelling through its material design, subtle movement, environmental reactions and tragic consequences, rather than exaggerated visual effects.

Saren's appearance must remain consistent in every scene: scarred, dark-haired, weathered, gaunt but physically capable, in worn bronze-and-leather armor with a faded crimson cloak.

The supernatural power must never turn the film into glossy high fantasy. Preserve believable weight, momentum, physical damage, natural human reactions and imperfect camera work.

Prioritize relentless rhythmic escalation, fast practical combat, dramatic silhouettes, massive physical scale, atmospheric depth and meaningful shot-to-shot continuity.

The most intense passages should consist of rapid, readable action fragments synchronised precisely to the music, while a handful of emotionally powerful close-ups establish the human cost of the sword.

The central idea is that a desperate warrior can save an entire civilization only by surrendering every memory of the people he wanted to save.

FINAL PRIORITY: Beat-perfect cuts, enormous sword-and-sorcery spectacle, aggressive organic handheld cinematography, terrifying ancient magic, genuine photorealism, and the atmosphere of a legendary lost 1970s dark-fantasy film.

———

In my opinion it's an unfair challenge as K4 clearly aims at a different target audience but I think its a great step forward.

paper poster beside the dress, progressively uncovering the word "LOVART" precisely
behind its fingers. The revealed lettering remains permanently readable.
Frame both the hand and letters clearly during this brief action.
The character performs one small aristocratic curtsy, keeping the beat compact.
Its TV head rises proudly, then suddenly sinks with theatrical heartbreak.
It notices the elderly woman waiting at the nearby crossing.

18–25 SECONDS: GRANDMOTHER
The character approaches the partially erased elderly woman. She sees the raised
hand and accepts the gentle contact. A careful pass across her cheek reveals
wrinkles and skin texture; a short pass over her sleeve reveals fabric and seams.
Detail follows the fingers precisely. Untouched areas remain erased.
The CRT character adopts exaggerated gentlemanly dignity: a deep bow, an offered
arm and a ceremonious escort across the narrow side street, only a few steps wide.
The camera follows continuously. The woman becomes amused.
At the opposite curb, the character gives a grand farewell. She continues walking.
The character pauses, then turns its screen toward the camera.

25–30 SECONDS: FINAL LENS WIPE
The CRT character approaches until its television head fills much of the frame.
The world behind it retains the contrast between permanently revealed surfaces
and untouched smudged reality. Hold a brief direct look into the lens.
It extends one hand and physically touches the camera's front glass.
This is the ONLY exception to local, contact-bound clearing: as the hand sweeps
across the lens, all remaining surface smudging throughout the world disappears.
The shot had no dirty-lens blur beforehand. This is a deliberate surreal exception,
triggered by lens contact, not an explanation that earlier wipes cleaned the lens.
Use the hand's movement as the visible clearing boundary. No cut, dissolve or flash.
Architecture, cobblestones, faces, fabric, cars and reflections become naturally
detailed, still photographed as analog black-and-white 35mm film.
The character lowers its hand. Its theatrical sadness falls away.
Replace the original human smile with a tiny knowing TV-head tilt, relaxed
shoulders and one quiet beat of stillness. No new face appears on the screen.
It exits frame right. The camera stops following and holds on the clear street.
The original LOVART boutique is naturally visible in the final composition;
its previously smudged fascia is now completely readable: "LOVART".
Plan the walking route and continuous camera position so the shop is visible here.
Let the physical sign complete the brand callback for the remaining final beat.
No additional camera move, zoom, end card or cut. END.

CAMERA AND FILM CHARACTER
Human-operated handheld 35mm camera, documentary-style 28–35mm lens.
Responsive walking pace, organic sway, small framing corrections and imperfect
reframing. The operator may briefly fall behind, then catch up physically.
Keep the hand and contacted surface sufficiently focused to read the effect.
No gimbal perfection, drones, impossible movement or abrupt viewpoint jumps.
Fine visible grain, organic contrast, subtle halation, gentle highlight rolloff,
natural motion blur, underexposed shadows, slight exposure fluctuations and gate weave.
Authentic 1950s Paris: old façades, cafés, cobblestones, period signage, appropriate
clothing and vintage automobiles. Inhabited and imperfect, never digitally pristine.
Newly revealed detail remains sharp 35mm photography, not modern digital 8K imagery.

NATIVE AUDIO
NO MUSIC. NO SCORE. NO MUSICAL STINGS. NO VOICE-OVER. NO DIALOGUE.
Only diegetic street ambience: footsteps, cloth movement, distant engines,
indistinct café chatter, a brief dog sound, pole contact and soft wiping friction.
Optional faint CRT electrical hum stays localized to the television head.
No musical rhythm, synthetic effect whooshes or magical reveal sound.
The final reveal retains the same natural street ambience.

CONTINUITY PRIORITIES AND NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
Exactly one continuous 30-second take with one camera and one CRT protagonist.
Character identity and costume match the written description throughout.
Object smudging belongs to surfaces, not the camera image.
Direct hand contact reveals only the contacted path until the final lens wipe.
Every cleared area stays cleared. Untouched areas remain smudged until the ending.
The dog, dress and grandmother demonstrate the same tactile rule.
Only the final lens wipe clears the entire world.
No cuts, hidden cuts, montage, time jumps, camera switching, teleportation,
identity drift, human-head replacement, additional protagonists,
instant transformations, premature global clearing, digital blur, magical effects,
modern street elements, polished gimbal motion or contemporary digital aesthetics.
No music of any kind.

prompts.prompt:
Cinematic Hotel Hallway Fight — Live-Action Video Prompt

FORMAT & VISUAL STYLE

Duration: 30 seconds
Frame rate: 24 fps
Aspect ratio: 16:9 widescreen
Visual style: Cinematic live-action martial arts action, photorealistic, high-end Hollywood action film aesthetic. Real human characters, realistic physics, natural skin textures, detailed fabric and environmental materials. Warm practical hotel lighting, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, realistic motion blur, dramatic cinematic contrast.
CHARACTERS
Two young adult female fighters, @image1 and @image2, using their respective reference images for facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, and overall appearance. Preserve their identities and outfits consistently throughout the entire sequence.
Three male attackers, using the three provided male reference images. Maintain each man's facial identity, hairstyle, build, and clothing consistently across all shots.

SETTING

A long, narrow, luxurious hotel corridor with an elegant black-and-gold color scheme, expensive framed paintings, ornate wall panels, polished brass details, plush red carpeting, and bright ceiling lights. The hallway extends deep into the background, creating strong perspective and a confined, tense atmosphere.

SHOT-BY-SHOT SEQUENCE

[00–06s] — The Ambush

Cinematic medium close-up of the two women emerging from the same hotel room into the luxurious hallway. One woman, @image1, calmly closes the door behind her using a keycard, while the other, @image2, looks down at her smartphone, seemingly unaware of the danger.

Three male fighters are already waiting farther down the corridor, watching them and preparing to attack. The camera slowly tracks backward as the women step into the hallway. Warm ceiling lights reflect off the polished wall details. Subtle tension builds as the attackers begin moving toward them.

[06–10s] — The First Strike

The leader suddenly lunges forward and throws a powerful punch toward @image1. She instantly snaps her head toward him and raises her index and middle fingers in front of her face in a precise, controlled martial arts gesture.

A subtle, invisible telekinetic force distorts the air. His fist stops abruptly in mid-air, as though striking an impenetrable barrier. An explosive pressure wave launches him backward into the opposite wall.

A brief burst of stylized blood spray accompanies the impact, leaving visible stains on his shirt and nearby wall. The camera captures the impact with a short, dramatic slow-motion beat before returning to normal speed. The other two attackers freeze in disbelief, then charge toward the women.

[10–16s] — Telekinetic Counterattack

Wide-angle tracking shot looking down the length of the hallway. @image2 puts away her phone, steps away from the wall, and assumes a calm martial arts stance.

With sharp finger-pointing gestures and controlled palm thrusts, she releases successive invisible force waves. One attacker is thrown sideways into a hotel room door, another is lifted off his feet and propelled backward, and the third slides rapidly across the red carpet.

Her hair and clothing react naturally to the pressure waves. The camera follows the action with fast lateral tracking, controlled whip pans, and subtle handheld movement. Every impact feels heavy and physical, with realistic momentum and environmental reactions.

[16–22s] — Hallway Destruction

The fight intensifies. Framed paintings tear loose from their hooks, plaster fragments break from the walls, and dust and splinters fill the corridor.

One attacker crashes into a reinforced door, leaving a visible dent. Another leaps toward @image2 but is intercepted mid-air by an invisible telekinetic strike and hurled backward through a cloud of dust.

@image2 remains composed, shifting smoothly between low martial arts stances and precise hand gestures. Her movements are economical and deliberate, contrasting with the chaotic motion of the attackers.

Use dynamic camera tracking, brief impact close-ups, realistic debris trajectories, and dramatic lighting through the airborne dust.

[22–27s] — The Final Shockwave

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind one of the remaining attackers. His shoulder and head are blurred in the foreground. At the far end of the corridor, @image2 stands firmly with both arms extended and her palms facing forward.

She thrusts both hands outward.

A massive, invisible pressure wave races down the hallway toward the camera. The air visibly ripples, ceiling lights flicker, hotel doors rattle violently, framed paintings shatter, and loose debris is swept toward the lens. A faint pinkish-red atmospheric distortion appears within the expanding shockwave.

The camera shakes subtly as the force reaches the foreground. Dust and small debris rush past the lens, briefly obscuring the view.

[27–30s] — Aftermath

The dust completely fills the frame, creating a natural transition. As it slowly settles, the damaged hallway becomes visible again.

The three attackers lie motionless or groan amid scattered debris, their clothing marked by dust and occasional bloodstains. The women stand together in the center of the corridor, calm and composed.

@image1 and @image2 hold controlled martial arts finger poses as their hair and clothing gradually settle. Blood droplets and dust fall slowly through the warm ceiling light. The camera performs a subtle, slow push-in and holds on the two women for the final beat.

End on a tense, cinematic stillness.

CAMERA & MOTION

Maintain coherent screen direction and spatial continuity throughout the fight. Use medium close-ups for facial reactions, wide shots to establish the hallway geography, low-angle shots for powerful impacts, and tracking shots for fast movement.

The women should move with precise, controlled martial arts choreography. The attackers should react with believable momentum and weight. Telekinetic effects should be mostly invisible, represented by air distortion, pressure waves, dust displacement, and environmental damage rather than bright magical beams.

Use brief speed ramps and slow motion only at key impact moments. Avoid excessive camera shake, random cuts, or disorienting movement.

LIGHTING & COLOR GRADING

Warm white and amber ceiling lights, a sophisticated black-and-gold interior, rich red carpeting, natural skin tones, cool teal-white shadows, and subtle warm highlights. Volumetric dust catches the overhead light. Realistic reflections, deep cinematic shadows, restrained contrast, and subtle film grain.

SOUND DESIGN

Deep cinematic bass impacts, sharp air-pressure whooshes, heavy body impacts, door slams, cracking plaster, shattering glass, rustling paintings, falling debris, and the reverberation of impacts through the enclosed corridor. A tense, low-frequency synth score builds during the confrontation and drops into near-silence during the final shot.

No dialogue. No narration. No subtitles. No on-screen text. No logos. No watermark.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

Anime, cartoon, CGI-looking characters, video game graphics, artificial skin, plastic textures, inconsistent faces, changing outfits, duplicate characters, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted fingers, floating objects without physical cause, inconsistent hallway layout, teleportation, weightless impacts, excessive gore, excessive camera shake, erratic editing, overexposed lighting, oversaturated colors, low resolution, flickering character identities, text, subtitles, watermarks.

prompts.prompt:
[GOAL]
Create a photorealistic 30-second short film titled conceptually “Every Day, Again.”

Show exactly 28 distinct everyday actions performed by the same working woman, from her morning alarm to falling asleep at night.

A relentless, funny-but-relatable busy-life montage: she rushes through her morning, eats while getting dressed, commutes, works at an office, returns home, handles chores, and finally collapses into bed.

Total runtime: EXACTLY 30 seconds.
Actions 1–26: one second each.
Action 27: two seconds.
Action 28: two seconds.

Do not render action numbers, timestamps, or titles.

[CHARACTER CONTINUITY]
One adult South Indian woman, late 20s, medium-brown skin, oval face, dark brown eyes, and long black hair.

Preserve her exact face, age, complexion, body proportions, and identity in every shot.

Use only these motivated appearance changes:
Morning at home: muted blue cotton pajamas, loose slightly messy hair.
Getting ready: cream blouse, charcoal trousers; hair becomes a practical low ponytail.
Office and commute: the same cream blouse, charcoal trousers, black flats, and tan shoulder bag.
Evening chores: the same office clothes, blouse sleeves rolled up.
Bedtime: the same blue pajamas from the opening, hair loose again.

Clothes change only at the designated cuts. No wardrobe morphing within a shot.

[WORLD CONTINUITY]
A modest contemporary apartment, a city bus commute, and a small ordinary office.

Apartment layout: bed beside a small bedside table; bathroom off the bedroom; kitchen counter beside the entry area; front door opening onto a corridor.

Office: the same desk, laptop, dark office chair, and plain ceramic mug.

Maintain the same home layout at morning and night.
Other commuters and coworkers may appear as indistinct background people; no featured secondary characters.

[CAMERA AND IMAGE]
Canon EOS 5D Mark IV DSLR visual character.
Canon EF 35mm f/1.4L II USM lens, operated at f/2.8 for action shots and f/1.8 for the opening and closing bedside portraits.

Natural spherical lens rendering.
Realistic depth of field; enough focus depth to read fast actions.
24fps, approximately 1/50-second shutter, believable motion blur.

Use mostly locked compositions and short, controlled handheld movements.
Create speed through precise editing, decisive gestures, and brief speed ramps—not continuous camera shaking.

Natural skin texture, real fabric creases, mild perspiration, believable household clutter.
No beauty filter, plastic skin, artificial HDR, or glossy commercial finish.

[ACTION 01 | 00–01s | ALARM]
Tight bedside composition, 35mm at f/1.8.
Her eyes snap open at the alarm. Her hand immediately slaps the phone to silence it.
Keep the phone display turned away from camera.
SFX: sharp alarm abruptly cut off by the tap.

[ACTION 02 | 01–02s | OUT OF BED]
Medium-wide, f/2.8.
She throws the blanket aside and swings both feet onto the floor in one urgent movement.
SFX: blanket whoosh, feet hitting the floor.
Hard cut on impact.

[ACTION 03 | 02–03s | BRUSHING]
Bathroom medium shot, f/2.8.
Already brushing her teeth, she makes two brisk brushing strokes with sleepy, irritated eyes.
A small amount of ordinary toothpaste foam.
SFX: toothbrush scrubbing.
No dialogue.

[ACTION 04 | 03–04s | FACE WASH]
Same bathroom, camera offset slightly.
She splashes one handful of water onto her face.
SFX: water splash.
Cut as the droplets fall.

[ACTION 05 | 04–05s | GETTING DRESSED]
Bedroom medium shot.
Now wearing charcoal trousers and an almost-buttoned cream blouse over an opaque camisole, she closes the final blouse button.
A piece of toast is already held between her lips.
Show no undressing.
SFX: fabric movement.

[ACTION 06 | 05–06s | BREAKFAST WHILE DRESSING]
Waist-up beside the kitchen counter.
She takes one hurried bite of the toast while her free hand tucks in the side of her blouse.
The remaining toast stays visibly in her hand.
SFX: toast crunch, fabric rustle.

[ACTION 07 | 06–07s | TYING HER HAIR]
Mirror-side medium shot.
Toast now rests on a plate below the mirror.
Her hair is already gathered; she pulls the elastic snug around a low ponytail.
SFX: quick hair and sleeve movement.

[ACTION 08 | 07–08s | PACKING LUNCH]
Kitchen medium-close shot.
She snaps the lid shut on a filled lunch container and pushes it into her open tan bag directly beside it.
SFX: plastic click, bag rustle.
One continuous directional movement.

[ACTION 09 | 08–09s | SHOES]
Low shot at the apartment entrance.
One black flat is already on. She pushes her other foot into the matching flat while steadying herself against the wall.
SFX: shoe scuff, foot tap.

[ACTION 10 | 09–10s | LOCKING UP]
Corridor medium shot.
Bag over her shoulder, she turns the key in the apartment door and immediately pivots to leave.
SFX: lock click, keys jingle.
Hard cut on the pivot.

[ACTION 11 | 10–11s | RUSHING FOR THE BUS]
Street medium-wide shot.
She takes three quick running steps toward a stationary bus with its doors open.
Her bag bounces with believable weight.
SFX: fast footsteps, idling engine.
The bus remains stopped.

[ACTION 12 | 11–12s | BOARDING]
Side view at the bus doorway.
She grips the rail and steps aboard.
SFX: shoe on metal step, bus-door hiss.
Cut before the doors close.

[ACTION 13 | 12–13s | OFFICE ARRIVAL]
Office entrance medium shot.
She taps her access card against the reader while still moving forward.
SFX: single access beep.
No readable signage or card text.

[ACTION 14 | 13–14s | OPENING THE LAPTOP]
Desk-level medium shot.
She drops into her office chair while lifting the laptop lid.
The bag is already hanging from the chair.
SFX: chair creak, laptop opening.

[ACTION 15 | 14–15s | TYPING]
Three-quarter medium-close shot.
She types rapidly, eyes fixed on the screen, shoulders slightly tense.
Keep the screen angled away so no text is legible.
SFX: dense keyboard clicks.

[ACTION 16 | 15–16s | PHONE CALL]
Medium portrait at the same desk.
Phone at her ear, she listens while reaching for her notebook.
English dialogue, brisk and natural:
“On it.”
SFX: office room tone under the line.

[ACTION 17 | 16–17s | TAKING NOTES]
Desk-side shot showing her hand and concentrated expression.
She writes one short note in an open notebook.
Writing remains too small to read.
SFX: pen scratching.
Cut on the final pen stroke.

[ACTION 18 | 17–18s | DESK LUNCH]
Medium shot, same desk, later daylight.
Her lunch container is open.
She takes one spoonful while continuing to look at the laptop.
SFX: spoon touching the container, quiet office ambience.
No speaking while chewing.

[ACTION 19 | 18–19s | WASHING HER MUG]
Office kitchenette medium-close shot.
She rotates the same ceramic mug once beneath a running tap.
SFX: water striking ceramic.
Match the circular movement into the next shot.

[ACTION 20 | 19–20s | FINALLY FINISHED]
Same office desk, now with dim evening light outside.
She firmly closes the laptop and releases a quick, tired breath.
SFX: laptop clack, audible exhale.
Hard cut on closure.

[ACTION 21 | 20–21s | COMMUTING HOME]
Bus interior medium portrait.
Seated beside the window, she rubs the bridge of her nose while evening lights pass outside.
Her tan bag rests on her lap.
SFX: engine rumble, window vibration.

[ACTION 22 | 21–22s | BACK HOME]
Apartment entry medium-wide shot.
She steps inside and drops her tan bag onto the entry chair.
Her shoulders fall for an instant.
SFX: bag thud, keys landing in a dish.
Cut before she can settle.

[ACTION 23 | 22–23s | COOKING DINNER]
Kitchen medium shot.
Still in her office clothes, sleeves now rolled up, she briskly stirs vegetables already cooking in a pan.
SFX: pan sizzling, spoon scraping.
Steam rises naturally.

[ACTION 24 | 23–24s | EATING DINNER]
Small dining-table medium shot.
She takes one tired bite from a simple meal.
Her posture is slouched; her movements remain hurried.
SFX: cutlery touching the plate.
No dialogue.

[ACTION 25 | 24–25s | WASHING DISHES]
Kitchen sink medium-close shot.
She scrubs the dinner plate with two quick sponge strokes.
SFX: wet sponge, running water.
No instant transformation of a full sink.

[ACTION 26 | 25–26s | LAUNDRY]
Laundry-corner medium shot.
She pushes a small armful of clothes into an open front-loading washing machine.
SFX: fabric tumbling against the drum.
Cut as her hands withdraw.

[ACTION 27 | 26–28s | GOOD NIGHT]
Hard cut to the bedroom.
She now wears the original blue pajamas; her hair is loose.

Medium-close portrait, 35mm at f/1.8.
Seated on the edge of the bed, she looks directly into the lens with exhausted eyes and a tiny, knowing smile.

English dialogue:
“Good night, everyone.”

Speak naturally within the two-second shot.
No additional words.
Background: warm bedside lamp, dark window.
SFX: soft breathing and quiet bedroom ambience.

[ACTION 28 | 28–30s | SLEEP]
Medium side view of the bed, 35mm at f/1.8.
At the cut she is already reclining, head just above the pillow.

Her head sinks into the pillow; she pulls the blanket to her shoulder and closes her eyes.
A slow exhale replaces the frantic sounds of the day.

Hold the final half-second on her still face.
No alarm restarting.
No end title.
End at exactly 30 seconds.

[EDITING RHYTHM]
Exactly 28 shots, one action per shot.

Shots 1–26 are exactly one second each.
Shots 27–28 are exactly two seconds each.

Use sharp hard cuts, match-on-action transitions, and everyday sound impacts to create a bullet-train rhythm.

Start most shots with the action already underway.
Show the recognizable fragment of each task, not its full real-time completion.

Use only mild speed ramps within the first 26 shots when needed.
Keep body mechanics, gravity, hand contact, and object weight credible.
Do not make her glide, teleport, or move with cartoon physics.

The final four seconds return to ordinary speed, letting the viewer feel her exhaustion.

[DAYLIGHT PROGRESSION]
Shots 1–10: early morning.
Shots 11–17: morning into midday.
Shots 18–19: afternoon.
Shots 20–21: evening.
Shots 22–28: nighttime.

Change time of day only across cuts.
Maintain consistent practical lighting within each location.

[AUDIO]
No music or narration.
Build the rhythm from alarm, footsteps, water, fabric, locks, bus sounds, keyboard taps, utensils, and household appliances.

All intelligible dialogue must be English.
Only two spoken lines:
“On it.”
“Good night, everyone.”

Same natural female voice throughout.
Clear lip sync.
Keep background conversations indistinct.
Allow the last shot to become noticeably quieter.

[EXCLUSIONS]
No subtitles, captions, timestamps, titles, readable screen text, logos, or watermarks.
No additional actions or split screens.
No duplicated character.
No facial drift, wardrobe drift, extra fingers, warped objects, or floating props.
No exaggerated comedy faces.
No glamorous posing.
No slow dissolves, decorative transitions, or excessive camera movement.

[FINAL FEELING]
An ordinary woman doing what millions of people do every day:
wake up, rush, work, come home, keep working, sleep.
Fast, recognizable, human, and quietly exhausting.

Create a 30-second pixel art music video based on the previous concept of a mysterious dancer and shadow performance behind a glowing amber screen inside a dark mansion at night.

The whole video must look like high-quality animated pixel art, with detailed lighting, smooth motion, rich warm colors, cinematic framing, and a dramatic performance feel.
The visual mood should combine:
haunting angel-like elegance

mysterious shadow-dance atmosphere
stylish K-pop performance energy

retro pixel-art aesthetics with modern cinematic movement
The dancer appears as a graceful angelic female performer, and later the sequence evolves into abstract shadow dance imagery behind a translucent golden screen.
VISUAL STYLE
High-detail pixel art

Smooth frame-by-frame animation

Warm amber, mustard yellow, antique gold, dark brown, charcoal black palette
Dramatic silhouette lighting
Slight analog glow and subtle grain
Mansion interior at night
Elegant dance choreography
Artistic shadow play
No realistic live-action rendering
No CGI look

modern K-pop beat
catchy rhythm

glossy synths
punchy kick and snare
emotional atmospheric pads
stylish dance-pop energy
feminine lead vocal
a short vocal line for lip sync around 3–4 seconds
polished idol-performance vibe
smooth transitions between intense beats and dreamy moments
VIDEO STRUCTURE
0–3 seconds | Opening Hook
Begin with a visually striking pixel-art angel dancer in a dark mansion hall.
A single female dancer appears centered behind a giant glowing golden translucent screen. She moves in a dramatic angel-like pose with arms spread wide. Long flowing translucent fabric or ribbon trails behind her like soft wings.

The shot begins with a drone-style overhead descending shot, simulated in pixel art, moving down from above toward the dancer in a cinematic sweep.

The rhythm begins immediately with a powerful K-pop intro hit.
The dancer’s movement is elegant, divine, mysterious, and instantly eye-catching.
3–4 seconds | Lip Sync Moment

She briefly looks toward camera and performs clear, synchronized lip sync for one short K-pop lyric line, around 1 second long.
Her mouth movement must match the lyric precisely in a stylized animated way.

"Follow my shadow tonight."

This moment should feel like a strong idol-performance hook.

4–8 seconds | Fast Track Dance Burst
The beat becomes more energetic.
Use fast-cut choreography and stylized motion.
The dancer spins quickly, fabric trailing like wings.
The screen glows brighter behind her.
Use rapid but readable edits and speed-ramp effects, combining quick dance beats with dynamic angle changes.

side angle
slight top-down drone angle

low-angle heroic shot
Keep all movement smooth and visually rhythmic.

8–13 seconds | Shadow Dance Expansion
Now introduce the second shadow figure behind the translucent amber screen.
The two dancers appear as dark pixel silhouettes, moving in synchronized contemporary dance.
Their arms extend and curve in expressive shapes, creating haunting elongated shadows.

The camera returns to a wider static cinematic frame, letting the choreography breathe.

The movement is elegant, mysterious, and artistic.
13–17 seconds | Slow Motion Highlight

Their silhouettes stretch softly across the glowing mustard-gold screen.
Fabric and hair move gracefully.

17–22 seconds | Aerial / Drone Performance Shot

Show the symmetry of the choreography from above.
The warm screen light reflects on the dark floor tiles.
The dancers rotate and shift position, creating an abstract visual pattern.
The music intensifies with stronger K-pop beat energy.

22–26 seconds | Fast Dance + Rhythm Sync
Return to medium and wide shots.
The angel dancer leads the performance while the shadow dancer echoes her movement.
Use:
speed ramps
fast rhythmic cuts

sharp pose transitions

dramatic arm lines
synchronized dance accents

26–30 seconds | Finale
For the ending, both dancers rise into one final dramatic pose behind the glowing screen.
The angel dancer stands center, arms lifted like wings, while the second figure mirrors from behind.
Their silhouettes briefly overlap into one striking abstract composition.

Use a final slow-motion finish for the last 2 seconds.
The music ends with a polished K-pop outro accent and lingering atmospheric synth.

CAMERA DIRECTIONS

medium frontal shots
close-up lip-sync shot
low-angle dramatic shot

wide cinematic silhouette shot

MOTION EFFECTS

slow-motion beauty shots during emotional or dramatic pose transitions

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

Keep the mansion atmosphere dark and cinematic

Make the angel dancer visually elegant and iconic

Include one short lip-sync moment around 3–4 seconds

prompts.prompt:
Clash of Aura Dragons

【style】
Cinematic dark-fantasy epic, photoreal CGI with volumetric aura lighting. Deep teal-and-amber colour grade, heavy atmospheric fog, rim-lit characters against a stormy dusk sky. Camera feel: sweeping crane and push-in, handheld energy in combat beats. Tone arc: calm standoff → explosive clash → lingering dread. Core idea: two swordsmen channel dragon-shaped aura smoke — violet versus orange — in a duel where the pressure of unseen power matters more than the blades.

【cast】
SI BOZZX — @Image1 fixes his face: sharp jaw, short black hair, battle-scarred leather armour with a dark crimson sash; right hand grips a straight longsword whose blade trails wisps of VIOLET aura smoke. SI NOX — @Image2 fixes his face: gaunt, pale skin, long white hair tied back, black hooded coat with silver trim; left hand holds a curved sabre whose blade trails wisps of ORANGE aura smoke. The SPACE — @Image3 fixes the arena: a ruined stone plaza at dusk, cracked flagstones, broken pillars, low fog rolling across the ground, distant lightning behind silhouetted mountains. The aura dragons are NOT creatures — they are dense streams of coloured smoke shaped like coiling dragon forms, semi-transparent, trailing from the sword blades; violet for Bozzx, orange for Nox. They writhe and billow but have no solid body, no eyes, no roar — only a low serpentine flow of glowing fog. Bozzx's armour, Nox's coat, the plaza layout, and the crack pattern on the flagstones must stay identical in every shot.

【shots】
SHOT 1｜00:00–00:05｜Dusk. Wide crane shot over the ruined plaza. Fog curls across cracked flagstones. SI BOZZX stands far left, SI NOX stands far right, thirty paces apart. Both hold their swords at their sides; thin trails of violet and orange aura smoke drift from the blades. Distant thunder rolls. SI BOZZX says: "Nox. Akhirnya kita berhadapan." SHOT 2｜00:05–00:10｜Push-in on SI NOX (@Image2). Wind lifts his white hair. Orange aura smoke from his sabre thickens, coiling into a loose serpentine shape that loops once around his arm. Only Nox is in frame — no other person appears. He says: "Kau terlalu percaya diri, Bozzx." SHOT 3｜00:10–00:16｜Slow tracking shot moving left to right between them. Both raise swords. Violet smoke erupts from Bozzx's blade, orange smoke from Nox's — each stream swells into a coiling dragon-shaped aura cloud, four metres long, translucent, billowing with dread pressure. The two aura-dragons lunge at each other and collide mid-air in a churning vortex of violet and orange fog. Deep bass rumble and crackling hiss on the soundtrack. SHOT 4｜00:16–00:22｜Medium two-shot. The aura vortex expands between the fighters. Bozzx pushes forward through the fog; Nox braces. Sparks and embers fly from the clashing blades inside the smoke. Bozzx says: "Kekuatanmu tidak cukup!" Nox replies: "Kita lihat saja." SHOT 5｜00:22–00:27｜Low-angle close on SI BOZZX (@Image1). Violet aura-dragon smoke spirals around him, lighting his face in purple glow. His eyes narrow. He drives his sword forward. Only Bozzx is in frame — no other person appears. He shouts: "Hancur!" SHOT 6｜00:27–00:30｜Wide shot pulling back. The two aura-dragons implode into a massive burst of mixed violet-orange smoke that floods the entire plaza. Both figures are swallowed by the fog. Only the silhouette of broken pillars remains. Low rumble fades to wind.

【rules】
Events happen strictly in the order written. SI BOZZX speaks first, then SI NOX, then both exchange lines during the clash, then Bozzx's final shout — every line said exactly as written, no paraphrasing, no added words. Eyelines: Bozzx and Nox always look at each other across the plaza until fog obscures them. Props: each sword stays in the hand it was cast with; aura smoke always trails from the blade, never from the body. The aura-dragons are smoke only — never solidify, never grow eyes or teeth, never roar; they coil, billow, and collide as coloured fog. Scale: each aura-dragon form reaches roughly four metres before impact, no larger. Lighting stays dusk throughout — never shifts to noon or full night. Avoid face changes between shots, extra limbs, duplicated swords, warped or random on-screen text, wrong spellings of names, and constant camera shake; camera moves are deliberate crane, push-in, track, or pull-back only.

2D cel-shaded anime, studio-quality animation, flat shading, shoujo, high school, reverse harem, romance, comedy, fictional characters, NO MUSIC.

Setting:

The corridor of an ordinary Japanese high school.

Scenario:

The second part of a character introduction scene between Juri and one of the love interests (Shun). The interaction is comedic and has the timing of a shoujo romantic comedy.

SHOT 1 — THE MYSTERIOUS HAND:

Frame 1 start on this frame.

Medium shot: Juri is sitting on the ground after falling over, looking slightly dazed. A handsome young man's hand reaches down into frame, offered to help her up. Juri looks at the hand, then up towards the unseen person.

SHOT 2 — THE REVEAL

Close-up on Juri's hand taking the young man's hand.

Medium shot: Young man gently pulls Juri to her feet.

Close-up of Shun, Reveal Shun's handsome face. He smiles apologetically.

Shun: "Oh, sorry! Didn't see you there."

As he finishes speaking, he casually flips his long hair in glorious, exaggerated slow motion. His hair catches the light. The camera briefly treats him like the most handsome boy in the world.

SHOT 3 — JURI'S BRAIN STOPS WORKING

Juri stares at Shun, completely mesmerised. Her eyes widen and sparkle. Her mouth hangs open.

Juri: "Wooooooooooooow..."

She begins making increasingly incoherent, flustered noises.

Juri: "Hum-a-nuh, hum-a-nuh, hum-a-nuh, hum-a-nuh! BRRRR!"

She shakes her head vigorously side-to-side in a cartoonish manner, trying desperately to regain her composure.

Juri: "You're hot... I mean, you're handsome... I mean, you're Juri, *I'M* Juri... Damnit..." (emphasis on the word "I'm")

Juri's confidence completely collapses. She lowers her head, looking embarrassed and slightly ashamed of herself, unable to believe what just came out of her mouth.

SHOT 4 — SHUN MAKES IT WORSE

Shun chuckles warmly, completely relaxed and unbothered.

Shun: "No worries. I kinda have that effect on girls."

He gives her a charming smile.

Shun: "Hey, you're pretty cute yourself."

SHOT 5 — TOTAL SYSTEM FAILURE

Juri freezes.

Juri's face turns bright red, starting at her neck and rapidly spreads upwards across her face, all the way to the top of her head. Use an exaggerated cartoon anime blush effect, as if her entire head is overheating.

Her eyes widen, then soften. She lets out a tiny, involuntary giggle.

Juri:"Hehehehehe..."

She giggles like a lovestruck schoolgirl, completely unlike her usual confident, mischievous self. She clasps her hands close to her chest, utterly smitten.

SHOT 6 — THE PERFECT EXIT

Shun smiles and turns away.

Shun: "Well, see you around."

He turns and walks away in ridiculously smooth, cinematic slow motion, his hair flowing dramatically as though he's starring in a romance film.

The camera follows him for a moment, presenting him as effortlessly cool.

CRASH!

Shun walks directly into a wall.

He pauses, slightly dazed. He scratches the back of his head with an embarrassed grin, then casually continues walking as if nothing happened.

Juri remains in the background, still blushing and giggling, completely oblivious to his embarrassing exit.

FINAL COMEDIC CONTRAST: Juri thinks she has just met the most perfect boy in existence. Shun is, in fact, a handsome dork.

A mostly sweet, youthful feminine voice with a subtle natural rasp that adds warmth and edge. She speaks with confident energy and a hint of playfulness, but her tone can flip into a sharp, biting snap when her tsundere side flares up, especially when she is flustered or trying to hide affection. No accent, clean English dub style.

Shun's voice:

Youthful, warm, medium-high masculine voice; charming, princely and slightly theatrical, with expressive romantic inflections and playful confidence. Naturally flirtatious, cheerful and gentlemanly, but endearingly airheaded. Smooth, exaggerated delivery for dramatic moments, yet sincere and relaxed in casual conversation. Tamaki Suoh-esque romantic-comedy energy.

FORMAT:

WORLD:

Narrow interior with plastic chairs, metal tables, hanging snacks, instant noodle shelves, bottled drinks, cigarette display, a glass jar of crackers, a rice cooker, a small fan, cheap fluorescent lights, slightly wet tiled floor, cluttered but realistic. Outside the warung is a narrow Jakarta street with parked motorbikes, messy cables, dim streetlights, and humid night air after light rain.

CHARACTER 01:
Lean adult Indonesian man in a dark jacket, plain t-shirt, cargo pants, sneakers. Alert, tense, compact movement, practical street-fight energy.

CHARACTER 02:
Lean adult Indonesian man in a faded overshirt, dark trousers, sandals. Calm but dangerous, quick reflexes, compact silat-inspired movement.

PRIMARY SURREAL RULE:
The first half of the fight is normal.
At the first major impact, gravity inside the warung shifts 90 degrees.
This is not a visual effect only.
The environment physically reorients.
Objects slide and fall sideways.
The fighters must adapt instantly and continue fighting on the wall and tilted surfaces.
The camera remains visually readable and cinematic, not chaotic.

STORY BEAT:
A tense confrontation in a cramped Jakarta warung becomes a surreal gravity-bending fight.

0:00–0:04

Character 01 steps in from the street, breathing slightly hard.
Character 02 is already inside near a metal table, watching him.

No dialogue yet.
Strong tension.

0:04–0:07

A wrist trap.
Short elbow.

A chair scrapes across the floor.
Keep the movement compact, believable, and aggressive.
No wasted motion.

0:11–0:14

The room rotates 90 degrees.
Chairs, cups, snack packs, a spoon jar, and loose objects slide and fall sideways.
The fighters lose balance for a split second.

0:14–0:18

Character 02 grabs a shelf edge to stabilize himself and counters with a low kick.
Character 01 catches the motion, slams Character 02 into a sideways table.
The camera tilts with the new gravity orientation but stays readable.
The warung now feels impossible yet physical.

0:18–0:22

Palm strike.
Parry.
Forearm block.
Shoulder redirect.
Short knee.
Character 01 uses a hanging rack for leverage.
Character 02 pushes off a tilted wall.

0:22–0:25

Enter a brief micro slow motion beat.
Dust, instant noodle crumbs, droplets from a tipped drink, and hanging snack wrappers suspend in the air.
Their bodies twist through the warped space.
Hold the slow motion under one second.

0:25–0:28

Character 01 lands a hard redirect and sends Character 02 sliding across the tilted wall toward the warung entrance.
Character 02 stops himself by grabbing the doorframe.
The outside Jakarta street is now visible behind him at a bizarre angle.

0:28–0:30
Gravity suddenly snaps back to normal.
Everything drops.
Tables slam down.
Chairs hit the floor.
Loose items crash.

Hard cut to black.

28mm and 35mm lens language.

No score.

"OBJETIVO
Crear un video cinematográfico de 30 segundos, con tono de parodia épica y tierna, inspirado en la escena clásica de Don Quijote y Sancho contra el molino, pero protagonizado por gatitos. Debe sentirse coherente, fluido y muy consistente entre planos.
REFERENCIAS DE PERSONAJES
Usa únicamente las hojas de personaje adjuntas como referencia visual obligatoria para mantener identidad, vestuario, proporciones y estilo.
[Hoja de personaje 1] Don Quijote gatito caballero. Gatito pequeño grisáceo, armadura de caballero, casco con visera levantada, capa clara, lanza larga estilo Don Quijote. Debe conservar exactamente su diseño de la hoja de personaje.
[Hoja de personaje 2] Sancho Panza gatito escudero. Gatito pequeño, naranja y gordete, con gorro campesino, ropa humilde y bastón. Debe conservar exactamente su diseño de la hoja de personaje.
[Hoja de personaje 3] Ficha de monturas. Don Quijote cabalga el burrito ligeramente más alto. Sancho cabalga el burrito algo más bajo y compacto.
ESTILO VISUAL Y TONO
Cinematográfico, realista pero adorable, con acabado de película. Los gatitos deben verse pequeños y expresivos, con movimiento creíble. Los burritos deben verse algo más realistas que caricaturescos. Tono de parodia tierna, épica y levemente dramática. Sin diálogo. La narración se apoya en actuación, encuadre y timing cómico.
ENTORNO Y ATMÓSFERA
Paisaje inspirado en La Mancha: camino de tierra o sendero rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, pasto amarillento, tierra clara, piedras, horizonte amplio, aire castellano, luz natural. Puede haber una fortaleza o construcciones lejanas muy discretas si ayuda al ambiente, pero no deben verse molinos al inicio ni en los primeros planos. Los molinos deben permanecer ocultos hasta el momento del gag final.
Luz de tarde suave, ligeramente dorada pero no excesiva. Ambiente abierto, algo de viento en el paisaje. El viento debe cobrar más fuerza en el momento heroico de Don Quijote.
REGLAS DE CONSISTENCIA
Mantener el mismo lugar, misma hora del día, misma dirección de la luz y misma continuidad espacial en todos los planos.
Don Quijote siempre va delante y sobre el burrito ligeramente más alto.
Sancho siempre va detrás o un poco más retrasado, sobre el burrito más pequeño.
Don Quijote porta una lanza, no una espada.
Sancho lleva su bastón.
Mantener el mismo diseño exacto de personajes, vestuario, armadura, ropajes y monturas en todos los planos.
No mostrar molinos antes del choque. Solo debe verse el molino después del impacto.
Las transiciones deben sentirse cinematográficas, con cortes limpios y continuidad de dirección.
La comicidad debe surgir del contraste entre la épica de Don Quijote y la realidad del golpe contra el molino.
ESTRUCTURA TEMPORAL EXACTA
Duración total: 30 segundos.
0:00 - 0:05
Plano lateral medio, composición similar a una silueta de Don Quijote y Sancho avanzando de perfil por el camino. Don Quijote va delante sobre su burrito, Sancho detrás en el suyo. Ambos cabalgan tranquilos y cansados. Sancho transmite agotamiento. No se ven molinos. Movimiento suave, paso lento, ambiente sereno.
0:05 - 0:08
Don Quijote se detiene en seco. Su burrito frena. Corte a un primer plano o plano medio corto de Don Quijote deteniendo la montura y mirando fijamente al horizonte con su carita pequeña y muy seria. Debe sentirse que ha percibido algo importante.
0:08 - 0:11
Plano de Sancho. Sancho se ve contrariado y confundido. No entiende por qué se han detenido. Baja torpemente del burrito, todavía cansado, mirando a Don Quijote con desconcierto.
0:11 - 0:15
Plano de Don Quijote ya en el suelo. Ha desmontado. Avanza unos pasos con solemnidad, caminando con su lanza. Entonces una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo desde arriba o desde un lado. Cuando la sombra lo cubre por completo, se detiene.
0:15 - 0:18
Plano heroico de Don Quijote. Se planta recto y quieto, con la lanza erguida, en una pose épica y decidida, inspirada en la pose frontal de su hoja de personaje. El viento sopla con fuerza y hace ondear sutilmente su capa y su pelaje. Debe sentirse como un momento grandioso, exageradamente heroico y un poco ridículo a la vez.
0:18 - 0:22
Primer plano o plano medio corto de Don Quijote en posición de ataque. Se tensa, baja ligeramente el centro de gravedad y arranca de golpe a embestir con toda la determinación del mundo hacia algo que todavía no vemos. La cámara no revela aún el objetivo.
0:22 - 0:26
Plano del impacto. Don Quijote embiste con la lanza contra una pared blanca de molino de viento. El choque es súbito y cómico. Rebota con violencia caricaturesca pero físicamente clara, cae boca arriba al suelo y queda inmóvil unos instantes, como si hubiera perdido el conocimiento.
0:26 - 0:28
Plano más abierto. Ahora sí se revela claramente que Don Quijote está tendido en el suelo, diminuto, delante de un molino de viento blanco tradicional manchego, similar a los de Campo de Criptana. El molino debe verse por primera vez aquí. Sancho puede aparecer al fondo o acercándose, pero sin robar protagonismo.
0:28 - 0:30
Plano final de Sancho, negando con la cabeza, frustrado y contrariado. Debe cerrar con una nota cómica, tierna y digna. Fin.
LENGUAJE DE CÁMARA
Usar lenguaje de cámara cinematográfico y limpio.
Priorizar planos medios, primeros planos expresivos y un plano abierto final para el reveal del molino.
Mantener continuidad lateral clara.
Evitar movimientos de cámara exagerados o caóticos.
Los cortes deben ser elegantes y narrativos.
ACCIÓN Y ACTUACIÓN
Don Quijote debe actuar como un héroe diminuto, serio, idealista y valiente.
Sancho debe actuar como compañero leal, cansado, prudente y confundido.
La actuación facial de ambos debe ser muy importante.
El gag debe sentirse claro: Don Quijote interpreta una amenaza épica donde en realidad hay un molino.
PROMPT MAESTRO
Genera un video cinematográfico de 30 segundos, consistente entre planos, basado en la parodia tierna y épica de Don Quijote y Sancho contra el molino, protagonizada por gatitos. Usa exclusivamente las hojas de personaje adjuntas como referencia obligatoria para Don Quijote gatito caballero, Sancho gatito escudero y sus dos burritos. Mantén exactamente los diseños, vestuario, armadura, ropajes y monturas de las referencias.
Ambientación: paisaje manchego realista, camino rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, hierba amarillenta, piedras, horizonte abierto, atmósfera castellana, luz de tarde suave. No mostrar molinos en los primeros planos ni al inicio. Solo revelar el molino después del choque. Estilo visual realista, cinematográfico, adorable, con burritos algo más realistas y menos caricaturescos. Sin diálogo.
Secuencia:
Plano 1. Plano lateral medio de ambos cabalgando de perfil por el camino, Don Quijote delante sobre el burrito un poco más alto y Sancho detrás sobre el burrito más bajo. Avanzan tranquilos y cansados, especialmente Sancho.
Plano 2. Don Quijote se detiene en seco, frena el burrito y mira fijamente al horizonte con expresión intensa.
Plano 3. Sancho, confundido y contrariado, baja del burrito sin entender qué ocurre.
Plano 4. Don Quijote desmonta y avanza unos pasos con su lanza. Una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo.
Plano 5. Cuando queda completamente cubierto por la sombra, se detiene y adopta una pose heroica, recta y quieta, con la lanza erguida. Sopla un viento fuerte que agita sutilmente su capa y su pelo.
Plano 6. Don Quijote entra en posición de ataque y embiste con decisión hacia un objetivo fuera de cámara.
Plano 7. Se revela el impacto: embiste contra la pared blanca de un molino de viento tradicional manchego, rebota y cae boca arriba al suelo, aturdido.
Plano 8. Plano abierto donde se ve a Don Quijote tumbado delante del molino, diminuto y derrotado.
Plano 9. Plano final de Sancho negando con la cabeza, frustrado, cerrando con humor tierno.
Importante: máxima consistencia visual entre planos, misma localización, misma luz, misma orientación, mismo diseño de personajes. Don Quijote siempre lleva una lanza, no una espada. Sancho mantiene su bastón. El tono debe ser una mezcla de épica, ternura y comedia visual.
10. EVITAR
No mostrar molinos antes del golpe.
No cambiar el diseño de los personajes entre planos.
No volver caricaturescos los burritos.
No hacer movimientos de cámara exagerados.
No introducir elementos modernos.
No convertir la escena en slapstick caótico; debe seguir sintiéndose cinematográfica."

【25s 镜头脚本】 镜头 1（00-03）中景拉全景｜腰高机位，斜向拉远。Luma 挂在石猫鼻下岩沿，洋红粉袋卡在上方甲缝，抬头观察；镜头拉开，露出百米石猫、残破穹顶与保护绳。 镜头 2（03-05）全身中景｜髋高机位，沿甲面横移。左脚踩低点、右脚尖钩住岩缘，身体贴紧岩壁横向移动，换手抓侧拉点，指节发力，神情紧绷。 镜头 3（05-08）低位仰拍近景｜贴面上跟，微倾斜。右脚持续钩牢，抬左腿、鞋跟卡入高点，髋部上提，身体反向配重摆动，左手换到鼻尖斜缝，粉袋来到头顶前方。 镜头 4（08-11）侧向跟拍全身｜肩高机位。左脚踩稳高点，松开右脚钩挂，重心带动身体向右摆荡，换手抓住鼻翼横缝，右脚踩上凸起甲缘岩点。 镜头 5（11-14）半身 + 鼻孔特写｜胸高机位，焦点切换。Luma 稳住重心，伸手勾回粉袋扣在腰侧；洒落镁粉被石猫吸入鼻孔，焦点转至鼻内颤动生物膜，散热瓣叶开始收紧蓄力。 镜头 6（14-17）侧全景｜鼻尖高度机位，侧向拉开。石猫深吸气蓄压，周边须根晃动；Luma 瞄准侧颊平台蹬离岩壁，绳索绷紧，沿绳弧向外摆开，远离鼻尖。 镜头 7（17-20）巨猫面部全景｜鼻部机位，跟随绳弧。石猫打出巨大喷嚏，白粉与气流弧线逆光散开；Luma 躲开主喷流，被边缘粉雾扫到面部，双脚靠近侧颊平台。 镜头 8（20-23）中景推近半身｜机位从髋高抬至眼高。Luma 抓稳裂缝、站上平台，镜头推向脸部，确认粉袋收好，冷静眨眼，保持攀岩平衡姿态。 镜头 9（23-25）固定中景｜胸高机位。Luma 双掌按脸补镁粉，脸上留下深色掌印，挑眉准备抓下一处岩点；石猫鼻内结构恢复平稳，画面切黑。

prompts.prompt: **CLAYMORE — 30秒终极黑暗奇幻史诗真人电影预告片****【核心视觉风格锁定】**制作一支严格30秒、极具史诗感、极高制作规格、极端震撼的真人黑暗奇幻电影预告片。影片应当像一部来自1980年代、预算惊人、制作华丽的黑暗奇幻史诗电影：高贵、阴郁、恐怖、浪漫、宏伟，充满古老命运感和视觉奇观。画面必须体现巨大实体场景、真实中世纪建筑、奢华服装、银色铠甲、雾气、月光、火焰、古老教堂、石桥、雪原、黑暗森林和 practical creature effects 所带来的重量感。故事背景不能依赖观众已经知道原作。必须在预告片内部，用视觉和动作快速建立整个世界。这是一个被食人怪物长期侵袭的中世纪世界。这些怪物潜伏在人类之中，能够伪装成人类外表，突然变形成可怕的怪物，吞食人类。为了对抗它们，一个神秘组织制造出一群半人半怪物的女战士。她们有苍白皮肤、银色眼睛、冰冷气质、银色护甲和巨大的双手剑。她们负责猎杀怪物，但每次释放自己的怪物力量，也会越来越接近彻底变成非人的怪物。这是一个关于猎人与怪物界限逐渐模糊的悲剧故事。整体气质必须神秘、庄严、残酷、华美、黑暗、悲剧性极强。不要动漫风格，不要游戏CGI风格，不要现代超级英雄视觉语言。必须像一部高预算、经典而恢弘的真人黑暗奇幻电影。**【摄影与镜头语言锁定】**摄影机：**Arriflex 35 BL3** 镜头：**Canon and Cooke Lenses (Cooke/Canon optics)**，使用40mm、50mm、75mm 影像质感：35mm Kodak motion picture film aesthetic 画幅：2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen画面具有1980年代高规格奇幻大片的电影感：银蓝色月光、深邃黑色阴影、火把和烛火的暖色反差、湿润石材反光、体积雾、柔和 bloom、优雅胶片颗粒、古老镜头缺陷、饱满但不现代的高端视觉质感。宽镜头必须宏伟、对称、充满宗教建筑般的庄严感。近景必须强调金属、皮肤、血液、眼睛、怪物骨骼和呼吸。战斗镜头使用猛烈手持、whip-pan、impact shake、rapid tracking movement 和突然的 rack focus。镜头动作应当激烈，但始终可读、昂贵、精准。怪物必须像1980年代顶级 dark fantasy practical creatures：大面积 prosthetics、animatronics、机械口器、湿润皮肤、骨刺、肌肉、翅膀和真实重量。任何怪物动作都必须具备物理惯性和生物质感。**【角色与外观锁定】**主角是 CLARE。CLARE 是一位年轻、沉默、危险的银眼女战士。她有短而整齐的浅银金色头发，苍白皮肤，锐利的银色眼睛，疲惫而克制的面容。她穿着银色金属护甲、深灰色战斗服和略显破损的深色披风，背负一柄巨大的双手宽刃大剑。她的动作精准、冷静、近乎无情，但在表情中仍然残留被压抑的人性与痛苦。另一个重要角色是 TERESA。TERESA 是一位更具传奇气质的银眼女战士。她比 CLARE 更从容、更温柔、更强大。她有长而柔软的浅金色长发，银色眼睛，苍白而近乎发光的肌肤，穿着优雅古老的银色铠甲。她是 CLARE 心中失去的温柔与人性象征，只在短暂闪回中出现，却必须极具情感力量。另一个核心角色是 PRISCILLA。PRISCILLA 最初看起来像一位年轻、纯净、几乎脆弱的银眼女战士，拥有浅色短发和空白而不安的神情。但在高潮中，她显露出真正的恐怖形态：一个巨大、扭曲、优雅而骇人的觉醒怪物，具有类人结构、独角、过长四肢、异常苍白的生物组织和巨大的骨质或肉质翅膀。她既圣洁又可怕，像灾难本身。所有角色的面貌、护甲、体型和武器必须在镜头之间保持高度一致。**【史诗配乐与音效锁定 — 最高优先级】**创作一段完整原创、**imperious ferocious epic fantasy score**，规模宏大、黑暗而华丽的30秒电影预告片配乐。160 BPM，4/4拍，20小节，30秒。音乐风格必须是 **imperious, ferocious, commanding, and savage aggressive epic cinematic score**，带有 dark fantasy grandeur，结合：- 巨大 orchestral war drums（沉重、权威、不可抗拒）- Gran cassa 和 timpani- 快速低音弦乐 ostinato（持续凶猛推进）- 激烈高音弦乐推进- French horns, trombones, bass brass（imperious, regal, threatening）- dark choir- cathedral organ- church bells- metallic impacts- sub-bass pulses- sword clashes, armor movement, creature breathing, stone debris, crackling fire, storm wind音乐从第一秒就进入。结构如下：开头立刻建立神秘恐怖和宏伟感，钟声、低频鼓点、低音弦乐进入。 随后动作节奏启动，弦乐和打击乐推进，怪物与战士的世界开始显现。 铜管和 choir 逐渐加入，世界规模扩大，怪物威胁升级。 音乐突然抽空，仅保留低频脉冲和稀薄氛围，为一句英文台词创造空间。 然后主高潮爆发，完整交响乐、铜管、管风琴、war drums 和 choir 全部进入，以每拍甚至半拍为单位进行激烈剪辑，充满 **imperious authority** 与 **ferocious aggression**，直至最后一击。**所有剪辑点必须精准落在音乐节拍上。** 每一个主要鼓点、铜管重击或低频冲击，都必须精确驱动画面剪辑、怪物动作、剑击、镜头切换或视觉揭示。**【30秒正式预告片】**BLACK. 一声深沉古老的教堂钟声在黑暗中回荡。紧接着，低频战争战鼓与低音弦乐进入。 HARD CUT. 宏伟宽镜头。一座被雾气与月光覆盖的中世纪城市。巨大的教堂尖塔、石桥和高墙耸立在夜色中。风吹动火把，浓雾掠过街道。 CUT. 狭窄石板街道中，CLARE 独自站立，背后巨剑清晰可见。 EXTREME CLOSE-UP. 她的银色眼睛反射出前方一个逐渐逼近的人影。音乐进入快速推进节奏。 HARD CUT ON BEAT. 那个普通村民突然扭曲变形。皮肤撕裂，四肢拉长，骨骼外突，头颅裂开，瞬间变成一头巨大的食人怪物。 CUT. CLARE 抽出背后的巨剑。刀刃出鞘声与战鼓重击同步。 CUT. 怪物扑来。CLARE 低身闪避，怪物的爪子撕碎身后的石柱。 CUT. 她转身挥出巨剑。剑刃重重撞击怪物骨爪，火花、石屑与黑血同时爆开。 CUT. 她从怪物下方穿过，披风在火光中甩动。铜管与 choir 逐渐加入。 CUT. 风雪中的荒原上，多名银眼女战士同时拔出巨剑。 CUT. 一座古老修道院在远处燃烧。 CUT. 数头怪物在钟楼与屋顶之间跳跃。 CUT. 极近特写：CLARE 的瞳孔轻微收缩，银色眼睛开始转为金色。 CUT. 闪回镜头。TERESA 站在一片安静、几乎神圣的光线中，长发被微风吹起。她低头看着年幼的 CLARE，神情温柔却带着无法挽回的悲伤。 CUT. 现实中，成年 CLARE 在暴雨中抬起头，神情压抑。音乐几乎完全抽空，只剩低频脉冲、风声和极微弱的 choir。 中近景。CLARE 独自站在黑暗教堂的入口处，雨水顺着铠甲流下。 她低沉而克制地说： CLARE: "I will not become one of them." 半秒寂静。FULL ORCHESTRAL EXPLOSION. 巨大的 war drums、铜管、organ、choir 与高速弦乐同时爆发。 高密度、完全由节奏驱动的动作蒙太奇（所有剪辑严格落在节拍上）： CLARE 在雨夜中高速冲刺。 巨剑与怪物利爪正面冲撞。 一头怪物撞破教堂彩窗。 银眼女战士们冲入浓雾。 一座石桥在战斗中崩裂。 TERESA 在闪回中缓慢转头。 CLARE 的双眼彻底变成金色。 她的表情出现非人的紧张变化。 巨大的阴影在教堂穹顶中展开。 PRISCILLA 的觉醒形态第一次完整出现。她拥有独角、苍白扭曲的身体和巨大的翅膀，像一场活着的神罚。 CLARE 抬起巨剑，朝这个庞然怪物冲去。 摄影机与她一起猛烈向前。 她用尽全力斩下巨剑，与整支配乐最强重音完全同步。 SMASH CUT TO BLACK. 最后一声远古钟鸣在黑暗中回荡，然后彻底结束。**【最终制作锁定】**整支预告片必须让完全不知道原作的人，也能清楚理解这个世界： 这是一个被食人怪物威胁的中世纪黑暗奇幻世界。 一群银眼女战士用巨剑猎杀怪物。 她们拥有怪物力量，但每次使用，都更接近失去自己的人性。 主角 CLARE 正在与怪物战斗，也在与自己体内的怪物战斗。必须保持1980年代高规格暗黑奇幻史诗电影的气质：宏伟、优雅、阴森、真实、昂贵、富有 practical spectacle。不要依赖“Claymore”这个名字本身来解释任何设定。所有关键信息都必须通过视觉、行为、对白和气氛传达。最终优先级： HIGH-PRODUCTION 1980s DARK FANTASY. **ARRIFLEX 35 BL3 + COOKE/CANON OPTICS.** **IMPERIOUS FEROCIOUS ORCHESTRAL SCORE.** PRACTICAL MONSTERS. TRAGIC SILVER-EYED WARRIORS. **BEAT-SYNCED EDITING (ALL CUTS LAND ON THE BEAT).** GOTHIC SPECTACLE. 严格时长：30秒。

Action：【名场面四（中）：双子核心白塔与摩天楼群拦腰折断】 毁天灭地的冷银绯红剑气余波横扫远景天际线——右侧深蓝玻璃幕墙高楼的数万块玻璃同一秒爆碎，紧接着左侧的米白模块化巨构高塔与远景中央偏右最醒目的巨型纯白双子核心摩天巨塔被剑气余波齐齐从腰部斜向切开，百米高的双子塔上半截顺着切面错位滑落、轰然倾斜倒塌，连环撞毁周围楼宇。

End State：图4中标志性的纯白双子摩天巨塔与周边七八栋高楼相继拦腰折断倾覆，冲天尘暴直插白积云。

【大招爆发】：全屏强震动，巨型纯白双子塔结构断裂、楼体倾覆的灰白混凝土烟尘与绯红残余剑气交织。

镜头 18（1.7s｜大全景・极高空鸟瞰俯视・缓慢拉远定格）

Start State：承接镜头 17，远景双子巨塔与摩天楼群倾覆砸地，环形尘暴向四面八方翻涌。

Action：【名场面四（下）：大全景展示半城废墟余波】 极高空鸟瞰整座城市，原本晴朗午后的巨型白积云被冲击波一剑劈开，下方从破败老街到远景双子巨塔被犁出一条长达数公里的巨大剑痕沟壑，数十栋建筑化为断壁残垣，环形尘暴席卷整座城市；唯有近景高架桥残骸上，白夜一袭米白宽裤与暗红腰封的身影独立于漫天烟尘之中。

End State：环形尘暴扩散至 21:9 银幕边缘，城市天际线彻底崩毁，画面在壮阔的废墟大全景中定格。

【大招爆发】：余波尘暴呈同心圆向外扩散，残存绯红粒子在午后阳光与烟尘中飘散，镜头由强震动渐归史诗定格。

Hard Lock（全局硬性锁死约束）

人物与服装锁死：主角「白夜」严格锁定图2形象（银白高马尾、黑挂脖胸衣、双臂黑绷带、暗红腰封、撕裂米白宽腿裤、赤足）；反派「荒猎」严格锁定图1形象（哑光黑机械头盔配右眼橙红单目镜头、黑围巾、炭黑长风衣、右肩黑毛领、左臂黑橙护腕；战损按镜 3→5→7→13–15 严格递进继承）。

武器与特效色彩锁死：白夜全程仅使用图2传统寒钢太刀+黑色刀鞘，固定识别色为冷银刀光 + 绯红剑气（#E60026）；荒猎全程仅使用图3黑钢青蓝电弧赛博战刀（镜 8–12 延展为十米青蓝雷刃，镜 13 被正面劈碎），固定识别色为电光青蓝（#00E5FF）配右眼橙红光点，严禁混色。

图4场景与破坏继承锁死：严格锁定图4晴朗午后暖光与废土亚太工业都市（前景积水柏油路、废弃皮卡、白色卫星锅、红底旧招牌 → 中景水泥跨街高架桥、橙红「2HG」巨幅广告牌工业堡垒 → 远景纯白双子核心摩天巨塔与玻璃高楼）；皮卡劈裂（镜 2）、沿街骑楼五重破洞（镜 6）、高架桥崩塌（镜 11）、「2HG」广告牌斜切粉碎（镜 13、16）与远景纯白双子巨塔拦腰折断（镜 17–18）全程物理继承。
